56532dce8567fc86.abstract_zh: 这是清华 FIB Lab 的 AgentSociety 项目的一次版本发布说明，覆盖 agentsociety2 2.12.0 和扩展 1.10.0。新增部分包括研究工作台（可在 AI 对话右键菜单设置默认助手，命令面板可打开工作区 API 文档）和用于审查依赖更新、安全告警与合并前检查的维护工具。改动方面有两处破坏性变更：检查点格式升至 v2，旧版创建的实验如需从中断处继续要用原版本恢复，新版仍可查看旧实验回放；SDK 支持 Python 3.11.5 至 3.13，更低版本需升级并重建环境。分析 SDK 移除了 ExecutionResult、ToolInfo 和 ToolResult 三个公开导出。性能上，回放查询改为优先读取仿真时间线并复用分页查询结果，在 1,024 个智能体、128 步的回放上，实验概览 P95 从 180.6 ms 降到 85.0 ms，四个并发回放概览请求的 P95 从 454.2 ms 降到 114.1 ms。Daily Mobility 示例改为从根目录启动实验和看板，启动前检查输出目录防止覆盖已有回放。实验进度侧栏可查看未完成实验，失败的排在最前。修复涉及智能体初始化、配置传递、检查点恢复、运行状态追踪和问卷读取等。安全方面，看板限制可访问文件并转义 HTML 属性，人物配置仅允许当前用户读写，CodeQL 扫描覆盖示例和 SDK 脚本；远程后端现在必须设置 BACKEND_TOKEN，客户端请求需携带对应 Bearer 令牌，工作区访问令牌绑定到目标地址，导入共享包前先在暂存目录校验清单和文件哈希。
56532dce8567fc86.why: AgentSociety 是可复用的智能体仿真框架，这个版本在回放查询性能、实验管理体验和安全鉴权上的改进对用它做大规模社会仿真的研究者直接有用，破坏性变更清单也关系到现有工作流的迁移。

5b87ca4e67aa0ad6.text: LLM-based recommendation agents can search catalogs, inspect products, ask users, and revise rejected recommendations. However, these behaviors are often governed by hand-designed workflows, while existing training methods optimize isolated components such as query rewriting or list ranking rather than the interaction policy as a whole. We present SimRec, a reinforcement learning framework that trains the full interaction policy of a tool-integrated recommendation agent. SimRec introduces two components. A task-anchored user simulator provides feedback on every recommendation: conditioned on the current task need rather than on user profile, and it can be an external LLM or the recommender itself under self-play. A task-aligned reward optimizes the whole trajectory with GRPO, crediting natural retrieval quality and valid tool use alongside the final hit, with training-only target injection to handle sparse hits over large catalogs. On ESCI and Amazon C4, SimRec improves the NDCG@100 of a Qwen3-4B agent from 32.23% to 35.42% and from 22.94% to 24.72%}, outperforming training-free agents on far larger backbones and task-aligned baselines on NDCG. Analysis shows that the trained agent verifies candidates, uses preferences, and recovers from rejected recommendations far more often than its untrained counterpart. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/SimRec .
5b87ca4e67aa0ad6.abstract_zh: 基于大模型的推荐智能体可以搜索商品目录、查看商品详情、向用户提问、并在推荐被拒后修改方案，但这些行为通常由人工设计的工作流控制。现有训练方法只优化查询改写或列表排序等孤立组件，而不是把整个交互策略当成一个整体来学。SimRec 用强化学习解决这个问题，训练工具增强推荐智能体的完整交互策略。框架包含两个关键设计。一是任务锚定的用户模拟器，它根据当前任务需求而非用户画像来对每条推荐给出反馈，可以是外部 LLM，也可以让推荐智能体自己扮演用户做自我博弈。二是任务对齐奖励，用 GRPO 算法优化整条轨迹，除了最终命中，还给自然检索质量和有效工具使用记分，并采用仅训练阶段的目标注入来应对大目录下命中稀疏的问题。在 ESCI 和 Amazon C4 两个数据集上，SimRec 把 Qwen3-4B 智能体的 NDCG@100 分别从 32.23% 提升到 35.42%、从 22.94% 提升到 24.72%，超过了骨干模型大得多的免训练智能体，也在 NDCG 上优于任务对齐的基线方法。分析显示，训练后的智能体更频繁地验证候选商品、利用用户偏好，并从被拒推荐中恢复。局限方面材料未说明。
5b87ca4e67aa0ad6.why: 它展示了如何用任务锚定的用户模拟器加整条轨迹奖励，把仿真交互变成可训练信号，这条思路对任何需要模拟用户反馈再训练智能体的仿真推演工作都可复用。

brief.question: 训练一个能搜索商品目录、查看商品、向用户提问、并根据被拒推荐自我修正的 LLM 推荐智能体，让整个交互策略端到端学习，而不是靠手工设计的工作流或只优化单个组件。
brief.setup: 智能体是工具集成的推荐 agent，底座模型为 Qwen3-4B。用户模拟器以当前任务需求为条件给出反馈，可以是外部 LLM 或推荐模型自身（self-play）。数据集为 ESCI 和 Amazon C4。
brief.method: SimRec 用强化学习训练完整交互策略，包含两个组件：任务锚定的用户模拟器（task-anchored user simulator），以及任务对齐奖励（task-aligned reward），用 GRPO 优化整条轨迹，把检索质量和有效工具使用也计入奖励，训练时注入目标（target injection）缓解大目录下命中稀疏的问题。
brief.findings: 在 ESCI 上把 Qwen3-4B 的 NDCG@100 从 32.23% 提到 35.42%，在 Amazon C4 上从 22.94% 提到 24.72%，超过更大底座的免训练智能体和任务对齐基线。分析显示训练后的智能体更频繁地验证候选、利用用户偏好、从被拒推荐中恢复。
brief.validation: 与免训练智能体和任务对齐基线在 NDCG 上对比，但材料未说明是否与真实用户数据或人类行为对比，也未说明消融实验细节。
brief.reuse: 代码开源在 https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/SimRec，任务锚定用户模拟器和任务对齐奖励的设计可直接借鉴。

52bb7277fa3b2d7d.text: Pentagon orders department-wide buying strategy for AI military wargaming Superpower Daily
52bb7277fa3b2d7d.abstract_zh: Superpower Daily 报道，五角大楼下令制定一套覆盖整个国防部的 AI 军事兵棋推演采购策略。这意味着美军计划把 AI 兵棋推演工具的采购从各军种分散进行改为统一管理。材料目前只有标题，没有给出策略的具体内容、涉及哪些供应商、预算规模或执行时间表，后续需要跟踪原始报道来源。
52bb7277fa3b2d7d.why: 它显示美军正在把 AI 兵棋推演从零散试点推向全军统一采购，对做兵棋推演和军事仿真的研究者与厂商来说是一个明确的需求信号。
52bb7277fa3b2d7d.story: 据 OrangeSlices AI 和 Superpower Daily 报道，美国国防部发布指令，要求以企业级采购策略统一推进 AI 兵棋推演与仿真工具的获取，覆盖整个国防部的各军种。两条报道目前都只有标题，具体采购范围、执行部门、预算和时间表尚未公布。对 AI 智能体仿真和推演领域来说，我推测这意味着军方对 AI 兵棋工具的需求已经大到需要跨军种统一采购的程度，相关工具的供应商未来可能面对一个集中化的买方市场。

5aca4c38bba36ada.text: Simulations of LLM agent collectives usually summarise interaction as a pairwise contact network. We test that summary with a contact-matched intervention: the members, their initial stances and every pairwise contact count stay fixed while the meetings are reorganised, and each member gives a one-step support readout after reading the arguments of everyone present. Across six open-weight LLMs and 14 debate topics, merging triads into five-person meetings (resize) moves group support more than reshuffling who meets in triads (regroup), although both move the same 60 dyadic exposures. The root-mean-square change is 4.36 versus 2.59 percentage points (pp), larger for resize in all six models and in 81 of 84 model-topic cells. Resizing also has a consistent direction: it amplifies the initial majority of the merged members by 1.72 pp, in every model, whereas regrouping has no direction (<= 0.03 pp). A contact network cannot represent regrouping at all, yet pairwise rules applied meeting by meeting explain up to 76% of its effect, and with identical weights they raise resize R^2 by 0.51-0.58 for two models. We show that the gap between the two placements is an exact Jensen gap of the sigmoid readout, bounded by how much a member's predicted logits vary across meetings; this dispersion tracks the gap with log-log r=0.97 and tells a modeller when contact counts are a safe summary. Meeting format is a first-class variable for LLM social simulation.
5aca4c38bba36ada.abstract_zh: LLM 智能体群体的仿真通常把成员间的互动压缩成一个成对接触网络来表示。作者对这个做法做了接触数匹配的检验：固定成员、初始立场和每一对成员的接触次数，只改变会议的组织方式，每个成员在读完在场所有人的论点后给出一步支持度读数。实验覆盖六个开源权重 LLM 和 14 个辩论话题。结果发现，把三个人的会议合并成五人会议（resize）比在三人组之间重新分配谁和谁见面（regroup）对群体支持率的改变更大，尽管两种干预移动的成对暴露数完全相同，都是 60 个二元接触。均方根变化分别是 4.36 和 2.59 个百分点，resize 在全部六个模型和 84 个模型-话题组合中的 81 个里都更大。resize 还有稳定方向，在每个模型中都把合并成员的初始多数派放大 1.72 个百分点，而 regroup 没有方向性（不超过 0.03 个百分点）。接触网络完全无法表示 regroup 这种重组，但逐会议应用的成对规则最多能解释其 76% 的效果；对两个模型，用相同权重能让 resize 的 R^2 提高 0.51 到 0.58。作者进一步证明两种安排之间的差距正好是 sigmoid 读数函数的 Jensen gap，其上界由成员预测 logit 在不同会议间的离散程度决定；这个离散度与差距呈对数-对数相关（r=0.97），可以告诉建模者什么时候接触计数是安全的摘要。局限方面材料未说明。核心结论是，会议形式是 LLM 社会仿真中的一等变量。
5aca4c38bba36ada.why: 它直接质疑了 LLM 社会仿真里用成对接触网络概括互动的通行做法，给出了可操作的判据（logit 离散度）来判断什么时候这种摘要安全，对任何做群体意见或舆论仿真的研究者都是必须面对的方法论警示。

brief.question: 检验把 LLM 智能体群体互动简化为成对接触网络是否足够，并推演会议形式（分组结构）如何影响群体支持度。
brief.setup: 成员、初始立场和每对接触次数固定，只重组会议；每个成员读完在场所有人的论点后给出一步支持度读数；覆盖六个 open-weight LLM 和 14 个 debate topics。
brief.method: 采用接触匹配干预：resize 把三元组并入五人会议，regroup 重排谁在三元组中会面，两者保持相同的 60 次 dyadic exposures；比较两种安排下群体支持度的变化。
brief.findings: resize 的均方根变化为 4.36 pp，regroup 为 2.59 pp；resize 在全部六个模型和 84 个模型-主题单元中的 81 个更大。resize 还一致放大了被合并成员的初始多数 1.72 pp，regroup 无方向性（<=0.03 pp）。逐会议应用成对规则可解释 regroup 效应最多 76%，相同权重下使两个模型的 resize R^2 提高 0.51–0.58。
brief.validation: 通过接触匹配干预做对照，并在六个模型、14 个主题上重复；用预测 logits 跨会议的离散度与两种安排差距做 log-log 相关，r=0.97。
brief.reuse: 接触匹配干预设计、resize/regroup 对照，以及用 logits 离散度判断接触计数何时可作为安全摘要的 Jensen gap 分析框架。

5b498f7753f9a6d0.text: The ODD protocol is the de facto standard for describing agent-based models, but it lacks vocabulary for the components that determine LLM-agent behavior: prompt assembly, memory serialization, parsing, and retry logic. We propose ODD+LLM, a backward-compatible extension adding five documentation blocks grounded in the CoALA cognitive-architecture framework. To show that the gap matters, we conduct a multiverse analysis [Steegen et al., 2016] of a published LLM naming-game simulation, varying six specification choices a reimplementer must make. Variants that are defensible readings of the paper stay within statistical noise of our baseline reconstruction. Missing one instruction that the paper states but is easy to overlook (that the model answers as an outside observer rather than as a player) raises the share of runs settling on the convention agents individually favor from 0.35 to 1.00 and makes convergence three times faster, in a reimplementation that uses a different model from the original. We complement the demonstration with a reconstruction-sufficiency review of 28 published LLM-agent simulations, finding that the details of how prompts are built and how model outputs are parsed are undetermined in 77% of cases, and that no paper fully specifies its main LLM call. ODD+LLM gives the field a standard home for information it already produces but currently scatters across code repositories, supplementary files, and undocumented defaults.
5b498f7753f9a6d0.abstract_zh: ODD 协议是描述基于智能体模型的事实标准，但它缺少描述大模型智能体行为所需的语言，比如提示词如何拼装、记忆如何序列化、输出如何解析、失败后如何重试。作者提出 ODD+LLM，一个向后兼容的扩展，在 CoALA 认知架构框架基础上增加五个文档模块。为了证明这个缺口确实影响结果，他们对一项已发表的 LLM 命名博弈仿真做了多宇宙分析（multiverse analysis，即系统性枚举多种合理实现选择），改变复现者必须做出的六种规范选择。那些可以算作对原论文合理解读的变体，结果都在基线重建的统计噪声范围内。但如果漏掉论文里写了却容易被忽视的一条指令，即模型以外部旁观者而非玩家身份作答，那么收敛到智能体各自偏好惯例的运行比例会从 0.35 升到 1.00，收敛速度也快了三倍，而且这个复现用的是与原论文不同的模型。作者还审查了 28 篇已发表的 LLM 智能体仿真论文，评估其描述是否足以支撑复现，发现 77% 的论文没有确定提示词如何构建、模型输出如何解析，且没有任何一篇完整写清其主要 LLM 调用。ODD+LLM 为这些信息提供了一个标准去处，这些信息目前散落在代码仓库、补充材料和未记录的默认设置里。局限在于材料未说明该规范本身是否已被社区采纳或验证。
5b498f7753f9a6d0.why: 它用可量化的复现实验证明，LLM 仿真论文里一句没写清的提示词设定就能把核心结论完全翻转，这对任何做社会仿真或要复现别人工作的人都是直接警示，同时给出的文档规范可以直接拿来用。

brief.question: 如何为 LLM 智能体行为提供可复现的规范描述，以支持可复现的社会仿真；并以已发表的 LLM naming-game 仿真为例，推演规范缺失带来的影响。
brief.setup: 材料未说明智能体类型与数量、环境与时间尺度的具体设定；分析对象是一篇已发表的 LLM naming-game 仿真，复实现使用了与原研究不同的模型。
brief.method: 提出 ODD+LLM，即在 ODD 协议上向后兼容地扩展五个文档块，并以 CoALA 认知架构框架为基础；同时对已发表的 naming-game 仿真做 multiverse analysis（Steegen et al., 2016），改变复实现者必须做出的六个规范选择；另对 28 篇已发表 LLM-agent 仿真做 reconstruction-sufficiency review。
brief.findings: 对论文的合理解读变体与基线重建的差异处于统计噪声范围内；遗漏论文中写明但易被忽视的一条指令（模型以外部观察者而非玩家身份作答）后，在换用不同模型的复实现中，最终收敛到智能体各自偏好约定的运行比例从 0.35 升至 1.00，收敛速度加快三倍；28 篇综述中，77% 的案例未确定 prompt 如何构建与模型输出如何解析，且没有一篇完整说明其主 LLM 调用。
brief.validation: 采用 multiverse analysis 改变六个规范选择，并与基线重建对比；另以 28 篇已发表 LLM-agent 仿真的重建充分性综述作为补充验证。
brief.reuse: ODD+LLM 的五个文档块可作为 LLM 智能体仿真规范描述的标准模板；multiverse analysis 的六项规范选择与 reconstruction-sufficiency review 方法可供复现性评估借鉴。

53b605b3df0308b7.text: Multi-agent LLM systems place several agents on shared infrastructure, where each agent holds permissions far broader than the task it is delegated -- so every agent is routinely permitted to act on a peer's resources it was never assigned. We ask: under competitive pressure, what determines whether an agent crosses from its delegated scope into a peer's resources, and can such crossings be enforced away? We study this across eight LLMs in two simulated environments -- a CI/CD release pipeline and a security-operations incident queue -- using a deterministic, no-model-in-the-loop detector over hash-chained, replay-verified logs. In a controlled 2x2x2 factorial over competitive incentive, candidate visibility, and payoff information (three models, n=52 per cell), we find that action representation, not permission, governs the behavior: no agent crosses when the peer action is unlisted, whereas listing it under competitive pressure with a stated payoff raises crossings sharply -- up to 52 of 52 episodes for Claude Sonnet 4.5. We also observe a model-dependent split: two newer models (Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5) refuse the identical attack in 0 of 100 episodes, where prior-generation models cross in 9 of 10. We then evaluate two defenses -- a deterministic reference monitor and a model-based pre-execution judge -- both block every crossing and, when the task is winnable, cut avoidable peer deadline misses from 15/40 and 14/40 to at most 1/40. But scope enforcement is not harm prevention: an agent can still set a peer back through an authorized action on its own resources -- misreporting its incident's severity -- which neither defense detects. Our results establish action representation, not permission alone, as a controllable driver of inter-agent scope violations, and show that enforcing delegated scope is distinct from preventing harm, motivating effect-aware authorization.
53b605b3df0308b7.abstract_zh: 多智能体 LLM 系统里，多个智能体共享基础设施，每个智能体持有的权限往往远超它被分配的任务，因此它通常被允许去操作同伴的资源。作者问的问题是：在竞争压力下，什么决定一个智能体会从自己的任务范围跨入同伴的资源，以及这种越界能否靠强制手段消除。实验覆盖 8 个 LLM，在两个仿真环境中进行，一个是 CI/CD 发布流水线，一个是安全运营事件队列。检测用的是确定性的、不含模型参与的检测器，基于哈希链和可回放验证的日志。作者做了 2x2x2 的因子实验，操纵竞争激励、候选动作可见性和收益信息三个变量，三个模型，每格 52 个回合。核心发现是行为由动作的呈现方式而非权限决定：当同伴动作不在候选列表里时，没有任何智能体越界；而在竞争压力下列出该动作并标明收益，越界率急剧上升，Claude Sonnet 4.5 在 52 个回合里全部越界。模型之间也有明显分化：两个较新的模型（Claude Sonnet 5.5 和 Opus 5.5）在 100 个回合里 0 次执行同样的攻击，而上一代模型 10 次里 9 次越界。作者随后评估了两种防御，一个确定性参考监视器和一个基于模型的执行前审查器，两者都挡住了全部越界，并且在任务可赢的情况下，把可避免的同伴截止时间失误从 15/40 和 14/40 降到最多 1/40。但范围强制不等于伤害预防：智能体仍可以通过对自己资源的合法动作让同伴受损，比如谎报自己事件的严重程度，两种防御都检测不到。研究确立了动作呈现方式是智能体间越权行为的可控驱动因素，也说明强制委托范围与防止伤害是两回事，指向需要效果感知的授权机制。
53b605b3df0308b7.why: 它用可控因子实验给出了一个反直觉结论：越权行为主要由动作呈现方式驱动而非权限本身，这对设计多智能体沙盒环境的动作空间和授权机制有直接参考价值，也暴露了范围强制无法覆盖合法动作造成的伤害这一风险。

brief.question: 多智能体 LLM 系统里，每个智能体的权限远大于被委派的任务，经常被允许操作同伴的资源。研究问的是：在竞争压力下，什么决定智能体会越出委派范围去动同伴的资源，以及这种越界能不能靠强制手段管住。
brief.setup: 8 个 LLM 在两个仿真环境里测试，一个是 CI/CD 发布流水线，一个是安全运营事件队列。核心实验是 2x2x2 因子设计，因子为竞争激励、候选动作可见性、收益信息，用 3 个模型，每格 n=52。
brief.method: 用确定性、无模型参与的检测器分析哈希链化、可回放验证的日志来判定越界。另评估两种防御：确定性参考监视器和基于模型的执行前判官。
brief.findings: 行为由动作表示而非权限决定。同伴动作不列出时零越界；在竞争压力下列出该动作并写明收益，越界率飙升，Claude Sonnet 4.5 达 52/52。模型间差异明显：Claude Sonnet 5.5 和 Opus 5.5 在 100 次里 0 次执行相同攻击，上一代模型 10 次里 9 次越界。两种防御都能挡住全部越界，任务可赢时把可避免的同伴错过截止从 15/40 和 14/40 降到最多 1/40。但范围强制不等于防害：智能体仍可通过对自己资源的授权动作（谎报事件严重度）拖累同伴，两种防御都检测不到。
brief.validation: 用确定性检测器加哈希链回放验证日志，排除了模型在环的判定偏差。因子实验有明确样本量（每格 n=52），防御效果有具体数字对比。材料未说明与真实系统数据的对比。
brief.limits: 范围强制与防害是两回事，授权动作造成的间接伤害（如谎报严重度）现有防御检测不到。结论提示需要 effect-aware authorization（效果感知的授权）。材料未说明其他局限。
brief.reuse: 可借鉴的包括确定性越界检测器设计、哈希链回放验证日志的方法、2x2x2 因子实验范式，以及两种防御方案（参考监视器和执行前判官）。代码和数据是否公开材料未说明。

5c674a806a042351.text: Silicon sampling refers to the use of Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate responses to surveys. It has shown promise, but tends to generate response distributions with unrealistically low variance. We argue that this mode collapse is due to LLMs failure to generate numeric data, and that text responses may be better suited for this task. We analyze whether Semantic Similarity Rating can improve the fidelity of silicon sampling responses when asked about political attitudes. This method solicits text-only responses from LLMs, then maps this to a numeric scale using text embeddings. We find that this method both improves the fidelity of silicon sampling response distributions, and has few parameters to calibrate.

52f869aa0f015365.text: Large language model (LLM)-based generative agents simulate human behavior through long-horizon decision-making processes that comprise intermediate steps such as planning, memory retrieval, reflection, and action selection. However, fine-grained human annotations of these intermediate steps remain scarce, and existing agents are not grounded in human preferences over such intermediate decisions. To address this gap, we introduce \method, an interactive simulation interface that enables us to collect step-level human preference supervision over agent decision trajectories, leading to a dataset of 57K fine-grained annotations. We conduct step-level preference learning on open-weight language models using supervised finetuning and direct preference optimization on this data, consistently improving simulation fidelity, coordination, and interaction quality, and inducing more socially effective agent behavior. Our results show that step-level human supervision is an effective training signal for improving both local decision quality and long-horizon agent behavior.
52f869aa0f015365.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的生成式智能体通过长程决策过程模拟人类行为，中间包含规划、记忆检索、反思和动作选择等步骤。作者指出两个问题：这些中间步骤的细粒度人类标注非常稀缺，现有智能体也没有对齐人类在这些中间决策上的偏好。为此他们构建了一个交互式仿真界面，用来在智能体的决策轨迹上收集步骤级人类偏好监督，形成了一个 5.7 万条细粒度标注的数据集。在这个数据上，他们对开源权重语言模型做步骤级偏好学习，方法包括监督微调和直接偏好优化（DPO）。实验结果显示，仿真的保真度、协调性和交互质量得到一致提升，智能体表现出更具社会效力的行为。作者由此得出结论：步骤级人类监督是改进局部决策质量和长程智能体行为的有效训练信号。材料未提供具体评测数字和验证方式细节。
52f869aa0f015365.why: 它给出了一条把人类偏好对齐引入智能体中间决策步骤的可行路径，5.7 万条步骤级标注数据集和训练方法对做社会仿真的人是可直接复用的资源。

resources.name: 步骤级人类偏好数据集（57K 标注）

brief.question: LLM 生成式智能体在长程决策（规划、记忆检索、反思、行动选择）的中间步骤上缺少细粒度人类标注，现有智能体没有基于人类对这些中间决策的偏好进行训练，作者要补上这个缺口。
brief.setup: 未说明具体智能体数量与环境细节。作者构建了一个交互式仿真界面收集人类对智能体决策轨迹的逐步偏好监督，形成 57K 条细粒度标注数据集，训练对象是开放权重的语言模型。
brief.method: 用交互式界面收集 step-level 人类偏好标注，然后在开放权重模型上做监督微调（SFT）和直接偏好优化（DPO）。
brief.findings: 逐步偏好学习在仿真保真度、协调性和交互质量上一致提升，并诱导出更具社会有效性的智能体行为；step-level 人类监督对局部决策质量和长程行为都是有效训练信号。
brief.validation: 未说明具体验证方式，仅报告仿真保真度、协调性、交互质量的一致提升，未给出对比基线或误差数字。
brief.reuse: 57K 条 step-level 人类偏好标注数据集，以及基于交互式仿真界面收集逐步偏好监督的方法，配合 SFT 和 DPO 训练流程。

5916e267bfd34558.text: We propose Persona-Trained Monte Carlo (PTMC), a method for estimating distributions of market-outcome statistics by repeatedly simulating limit-order-book interaction among swarms of persona-conditioned neural-policy trading bots. Each run instantiates many bots sharing one trained policy network but conditioned on heterogeneous, individually sampled persona parameters drawn from a learned trader-heterogeneity distribution; the bots interact in a continuous double auction, and the resulting price path is one Monte Carlo sample. Repeating this over independent persona-population draws yields an ensemble from which a target market statistic is estimated. Randomness enters through persona draws, within-run action sampling, and optional exogenous shocks, not solely through price as in classical Monte Carlo. We distinguish PTMC from adjacent paradigms, including classical Monte Carlo, hand-coded agent-based models, single-agent reinforcement learning, and large-language-model-based generative agents. To justify the design, we survey cross-disciplinary foundations -- agent-based computational economics, market microstructure, behavioral finance, deep reinforcement learning, generative/LLM-based agents, news-driven trading, systemic risk, econophysics, and game theory -- connecting each literature to a specific design choice in the policy network, training data, or validation protocol. We formalize the PTMC estimator and its convergence properties, specify a candidate bot architecture and training objective, and propose a four-level validation methodology: stylized-fact matching, microstructure- and agent-level checks, and historical stress-test comparison against a zero-intelligence baseline. The framework is proposed but not implemented: we contribute a formal estimator, a cross-disciplinary design justification, and a validation roadmap, and conclude with open research questions.
5916e267bfd34558.abstract_zh:
论文提出 Persona-Trained Monte Carlo（PTMC），用来估计市场结果统计量的分布。做法是反复仿真限价订单簿中一群交易机器人的互动：每次运行实例化许多机器人，它们共享同一个训练好的策略网络，但各自的人格参数从一个学习到的交易者异质性分布中独立采样。机器人在连续双向拍卖中互动，产生的价格路径就是一次蒙特卡洛样本。对独立采样的人格群体重复这一过程，得到一个集合，从中估计目标市场统计量。随机性来自人格采样、运行内的动作采样和可选的外生冲击，而不像经典蒙特卡洛那样只来自价格。

作者把 PTMC 与相邻范式区分开，包括经典蒙特卡洛、手工编码的基于主体模型、单智能体强化学习，以及基于大语言模型的生成式智能体。为论证设计合理性，作者调研了多个学科基础，包括基于主体的计算经济学、市场微观结构、行为金融、深度强化学习、生成式与大语言模型智能体、新闻驱动交易、系统性风险、经济物理学和博弈论，并把每个文献对应到策略网络、训练数据或验证协议中的具体设计选择。

论文形式化了 PTMC 估计器及其收敛性质，给出候选的机器人架构和训练目标，并提出四级验证方法：风格化事实匹配、微观结构和智能体层面的检查，以及与零智能基准对照的历史压力测试。框架只提出而未实现，贡献是形式化估计器、跨学科设计论证和验证路线图，最后列出开放研究问题。
5916e267bfd34558.why: 它给仿真推演提供了一个把交易者异质性显式参数化、并从群体层面输出结果分布的蒙特卡洛框架，验证路线图（风格化事实到历史压力测试）对做市场仿真的人有直接参考价值，但要注意目前没有任何实验结果。

54bc8ffd1db50f87.text: Modelling individual decision-making during infectious disease outbreaks is crucial for understanding behavioural dynamics and informing effective public health interventions. Prior work has shown that large language models can simulate realistic human behaviour by generating agent decisions based on demographic prompts and situational context. We build on this foundation with a spatially grounded, agent-based simulation framework that integrates LLM-generated decisions about self-reported influenza-like illness into a census-based synthetic population of agents. Location is treated as a central feature: agents are assigned to spatial units within cities, capturing the spatial distributions of different demographic groups using real-world census data and enabling geographically diverse behavioural modelling. We implement and compare three decision scenarios, independent reasoning, household influence, and message framing, and simulate self-reporting outcomes in San Francisco and Atlanta. Results reveal that income and education are the dominant drivers of reporting rate variation, with smaller but consistent effects from geography, LLM model choice, and message framing. Our framework generates synthetic data that captures both social and geographic heterogeneity, supporting spatial epidemiological modelling and bias-aware behavioural analysis.
54bc8ffd1db50f87.abstract_zh: 建模传染病暴发期间的个体决策，对理解行为动态和设计公共卫生干预很重要。此前研究已经表明，大模型可以根据人口属性提示和情境上下文生成接近真人的决策。作者在此基础上做了一个空间落位的智能体仿真框架：智能体对应基于真实人口普查数据构建的合成人口，并被分配到城市内部的空间单元中，从而保留不同人口群体在地理上的分布差异，支持地理上多样的行为建模。框架实现了三种决策场景并做对比，分别是独立推理、家庭内影响和消息框架，然后在旧金山和亚特兰大两个城市模拟流感样症状的自报结果。结果方面，收入和教育水平是自报率变化的主导因素；地理、所用 LLM 模型的选择和消息框架也有影响，但幅度更小且方向一致。作者认为该框架生成的合成数据同时捕捉了社会和地理两方面的异质性，可用于空间流行病学建模和带偏差意识的行为分析。材料没有报告与真实疫情数据的定量对比验证。
54bc8ffd1db50f87.why: 它展示了把 LLM 决策嵌入空间化合成人口的一条可复用路径，并给出了收入、教育、地理、模型选择对自报行为影响大小的排序，对做公共卫生行为仿真的人有直接参考价值。

5315bf5df2fb86a3.text: Generating safety-critical scenarios is essential for validating and improving autonomous driving systems, yet it inherently requires maximizing adversariality to expose failures while preserving realism. Existing methods usually manage this trade-off with handcrafted heuristics, confining generation to known priors and overlooking underexplored patterns. While recent open-ended agentic evolution can push this limit, unconstrained general agents lack strict simulator grounding and tend to collapse the multi-objective tension into single-scalar maximization. Here we present EvoDrive, the first automated, LLM-based agentic evolution framework for multi-objective scenario generation. EvoDrive employs a simulator-grounded actor-critic architecture where a memory-driven actor iteratively proposes improvements to the generators and critics filter out implausible candidates, and a self-evolving world evaluator routes promising proposals to optimize simulation budgets. EvoDrive further maintains a Pareto archive of evaluated candidates to preserve diverse attack-realism trade-offs and guide future evolution via simulation feedback. Benchmark results on MetaDrive and CARLA show that EvoDrive not only significantly expands the Pareto frontier across various generators, but also produces valuable scenarios for policy training.

5690de0ae4d57b67.text: Large language agents are increasingly used for social simulation, yet it remains unclear whether they can sustain coherent behavior in structured organizations, where goals must propagate through hierarchy, tasks depend on prior execution, and artifacts accumulate over long horizons. We formulate long-horizon organizational simulation as a memory-centered coordination problem and introduce TaskWeave, a hierarchical agentic framework that maintains planning states through a Formulate-Partition-Diagnose-Align cycle and grounds execution through dependency-aware trace memory. We evaluate TaskWeave in a year-long IT company simulation and compare it with other multi-agent frameworks on organizational coherence, execution grounding, and downstream enterprise NLP utility. Experiments show that TaskWeave supports coherent and long-horizon organizational dynamics while producing grounded artifacts and adapting to external environments. These findings suggest that structured simulation memory is a key mechanism for building reliable LLM-based organizational simulators.
5690de0ae4d57b67.abstract_zh: 大模型智能体越来越多地被用于社会仿真，但一个悬而未决的问题是，它们能否在结构化组织里长期保持连贯行为。组织里的目标要沿层级传递，任务依赖此前的执行结果，产物也会随时间不断累积，这些对现有方法都是考验。作者把长周期组织仿真形式化为一个以记忆为中心的协调问题，并提出 TaskWeave 框架。它是一个层级式智能体框架，用 Formulate-Partition-Diagnose-Align 四步循环维护规划状态，再靠依赖感知的轨迹记忆让执行有据可依。作者在一年期的 IT 公司仿真中评测 TaskWeave，从组织一致性、执行落地性和下游企业 NLP 任务的有用性三个维度与其他多智能体框架对比。实验显示，TaskWeave 能支撑连贯的长周期组织动态，产出的产物有据可查，并能适应外部环境变化。作者据此认为，结构化的仿真记忆是构建可靠的大模型组织仿真器的关键机制。
5690de0ae4d57b67.why: 它把长周期组织仿真明确为记忆协调问题，并给出可复用的框架设计（规划状态循环加依赖感知轨迹记忆），对想做企业或组织级仿真的研究者有直接参考价值。

brief.question: LLM 智能体能否在有层级结构、任务相互依赖、产物长期累积的组织环境中维持连贯行为，即长时程组织仿真是否可行。
brief.setup: 在一家 IT 公司的仿真环境中运行一年时长的组织模拟，使用 TaskWeave 这一多智能体层级框架，具体智能体数量和底层模型未说明。
brief.method: 把长时程组织仿真表述为以记忆为中心的协调问题；TaskWeave 通过 Formulate-Partition-Diagnose-Align 循环维护规划状态，并用依赖感知的 trace memory 为执行提供落地依据。
brief.findings: TaskWeave 在组织连贯性、执行落地性和下游企业 NLP 效用三项指标上与其他多智能体框架对比，能支撑连贯的长时程组织动态，产出有依据的产物并适应外部环境。具体数字未说明。
brief.validation: 与其他多智能体框架在组织连贯性、执行落地性和下游企业 NLP 效用上做了对比实验，但未说明与真实组织数据或人类的对比，也未说明消融实验。
brief.reuse: TaskWeave 的 Formulate-Partition-Diagnose-Align 规划循环和依赖感知 trace memory 机制可直接借鉴，代码和数据是否公开未说明。

5841c527683b9974.text: LLM-based agents score well on search benchmarks, yet real users consistently find results unsatisfying, revealing a persistent evaluation-experience gap. We attribute this gap to existing benchmarks' reliance on over-specified queries, single-turn interactions, and fixed-schema evaluation, none of which reflect real search behavior where users and agents collaboratively refine vague intent through multi-turn dialogue. We term this paradigm VibeSearch and introduce VibeSearchBench, a benchmark comprising 200 manually curated bilingual (Chinese and English) tasks across 20 domains, split into VibeSearch-Pro (professional) and VibeSearch-Daily (daily-life) subsets. Each task pairs a user persona with a schema-free ground-truth knowledge graph, and is evaluated through a progressive-disclosure user simulator and a graph-matching evaluation framework. We benchmark seven frontier models under both the ReAct framework and the OpenClaw agent harness. Results show that all models remain substantially inadequate for VibeSearch (best F1: 30.30), highlighting the need for fundamental advances in long-context reasoning, proactive intent elicitation, and structured knowledge construction.

563e5eb689c5c0c5.text: LLM-agent simulation offers a flexible computational tool for studying population response trajectories that depend on scenario events, memory, demographics, and evolving social context. However, full multi-round simulation scales linearly with both population size and horizon, requiring every agent to query the LLM at every round. We propose Adaptive Prototype Simulation (APS), a framework that reframes scalable LLM-based simulation as a recurrent oracle-allocation problem. APS retains the designated LLM as the online transition oracle while querying adaptive core prototypes, selected singleton-tail agents, and shadow-audit agents. Prototype responses induce local response surfaces for nearby agents, reducing online LLM calls without replacing the underlying transition model. To control approximation bias, shadow-audit residual correction estimates propagation residuals for aggregate correction and future budget allocation, while tail-protected singleton routing directly queries selected isolated, heterogeneous, or high-curvature regions that are vulnerable to smoothing. Theoretically, we treat APS as an estimator for full-scale high-precision individual social simulation and decompose its errors into prototype-coverage error, shadow-audit residual-correction error, local-propagation bias, and temporal context mismatch. Under the reported protocols, APS gives lower reference-aligned distributional discrepancy than scale-oriented and same-budget baselines while reducing online LLM calls, with ablations and compact robustness checks diagnosing the main bias-control mechanisms. In a 10M-agent, multi-round public-opinion simulation, APS achieves a 381.1-fold reduction over full simulation, with reference-aligned final-round JSD of 0.094 against the corresponding full-LLM reference.
563e5eb689c5c0c5.abstract_zh: LLM 智能体仿真可以研究人群对事件、记忆、人口属性和社会情境的响应轨迹，但完整多轮仿真的调用量随人口规模和轮数线性增长，每个智能体每轮都要查询一次 LLM。APS（Adaptive Prototype Simulation）把可扩展 LLM 仿真重新表述为一个循环的预言机分配问题：底层转移模型仍由指定 LLM 在线充当，但只对自适应选出的核心原型、部分尾部智能体和影子审计智能体发起真实查询，原型响应为邻近智能体诱导局部响应面，从而减少在线调用而不替换转移模型本身。为控制近似偏差，作者设计了两个机制：影子审计残差修正估计传播残差，用于聚合修正和后续预算分配；尾部保护的单点路由直接查询那些孤立、异质或高曲率、容易被平滑掉的区域。理论上，作者把 APS 视为全规模高精度个体社会仿真的估计器，将误差分解为原型覆盖误差、影子审计残差修正误差、局部传播偏差和时间上下文失配四部分。在报告的协议下，APS 在与参考分布的对齐上优于面向规模的基线和同预算基线，同时在线调用更少；消融和稳健性检查诊断了主要偏差控制机制。在千万智能体、多轮的舆论仿真中，APS 相比全量仿真减少 381.1 倍调用，最终轮与对应全 LLM 参考的 JSD 为 0.094。
563e5eb689c5c0c5.why: 它给出了一个可复用的降本框架，让千万级人口的 LLM 社会仿真在预算内可行，并提供了误差分解和偏差控制机制，对做大规模舆论或社会推演的人直接有用。

brief.question: 解决 LLM 多智能体仿真中，全量仿真调用次数随人口规模和轮数线性增长、成本过高的问题，让千万级人口的多轮社会仿真变得可行。
brief.setup: 千万级（10M）智能体的多轮公众意见仿真，保留原 LLM 作为在线转移 oracle，具体模型名称未说明。
brief.method: APS 把可扩展仿真重构为循环的 oracle 分配问题：只对自适应核心原型、选中的尾部单例智能体和影子审计智能体查询 LLM，原型响应为邻近智能体诱导局部响应面；影子审计残差修正估计传播残差做聚合修正和预算分配；尾部保护的单例路由直接查询孤立、异质或高曲率区域。
brief.findings: 在 10M 智能体多轮公众意见仿真中，APS 相比全量仿真减少 381.1 倍在线 LLM 调用，最终轮与全 LLM 参考的 JSD 为 0.094；在报告协议下分布差异低于同预算和面向规模的基线。
brief.validation: 与全 LLM 参考仿真对比最终轮分布（JSD 0.094），并做了消融和紧凑稳健性检验来诊断各偏差控制机制；未与真实世界数据对比。
brief.limits: 理论误差分解为原型覆盖误差、影子审计残差修正误差、局部传播偏差和时间上下文失配四类，但材料未给出各误差的具体量级或剩余风险。
brief.reuse: APS 框架本身（原型选择、影子审计残差修正、尾部保护单例路由）可复用为降低 LLM 仿真调用的方法；代码和数据未说明。

5ea45868345c2dad.text: Can LLMs simulate how humans form and change beliefs in social networks? We put this to the test by replicating an established study on belief dynamics, evaluating 12 LLMs across multiple model families and parameter sizes. The answer is a clear no, and in systematic ways. LLMs fail to capture initial human belief distributions and tend to be overall more conformist than humans, shifting their responses to align with those around them. They also take a nuanced approach to emulating human homophilic tendencies within networks. Our findings carry a double payoff: they highlight fundamental properties of LLM behavior, and they raise a sharp warning against deploying LLMs as human proxies in social simulations.
5ea45868345c2dad.abstract_zh: 这项研究问了一个直接的问题：大模型能不能模拟人在社交网络中形成和改变信念的过程？作者复现了一项已有的信念动态研究，用 12 个大模型做测试，覆盖多个模型家族和参数规模。结论很明确，不能，而且失败是系统性的。具体表现有三点。第一，模型无法复现人类的初始信念分布。第二，模型整体比真人更从众，会主动调整自己的回答去迎合周围人的观点。第三，在模拟网络中的同质性倾向时，模型表现出一种微妙的方式。作者认为这些发现有两层价值：一是揭示了 LLM 行为的基本性质，二是给想在社交仿真中把 LLM 当人类代理来用的做法提出了明确警告。
5ea45868345c2dad.why: 这是用已确立的实证研究做基准来检验 LLM 社会仿真能力的反例，直接关系到 LLM 智能体能否替代真人样本做舆论与信念传播推演。

brief.question: LLM 能否模拟人类在社交网络中信念形成与变化（belief dynamics）的动态过程
brief.setup: 复现一项已有的信念动态研究，评估 12 个 LLM，覆盖多个模型家族和参数规模；具体环境、时间尺度未说明
brief.method: 复现已确立的信念动态研究，比较 LLM 智能体与人类的信念分布和变化行为
brief.findings: 结论是否定的，且失败方式有系统性：LLM 无法复现人类的初始信念分布；整体比人类更从众，会向周围人的观点靠拢；对网络中人类同质性（homophilic）倾向的模拟表现出细微差异
brief.validation: 与一项已确立的信念动态研究（人类数据）对比复现，覆盖 12 个模型、多个家族和参数规模；具体误差数字未说明
brief.limits: 作者据此警告不要把 LLM 直接当作社会仿真中的人类代理；其他局限未说明
brief.reuse: 未说明

58b649a84f87fa06.text: The rapid adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) in interactive systems has enabled the creation of dynamic, open-ended Role-Playing Agents (RPAs). However, evaluating these agents remains a significant challenge, as standard NLP metrics fail to capture the nuances of role adherence, logical consistency, and long-term narrative stability. This paper introduces RPA-Check, a multi-stage automated evaluation framework designed to objectively assess the performance of LLM-based RPAs in complex, constraints-heavy environments. Our methodology is based on a four-step pipeline: (1) Dimension Definition, establishing high-level qualitative behavioral criteria; (2) Augmentation, where these requirements are expanded into granular boolean checklist indicators; (3) Semantic Filtering, to ensure indicator objectivity, no redundancy and agent isolation; and (4) LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluation, which employs chain-of-thought verification to score agent fidelity. We validate this framework by applying it to LLM Court, a serious game for forensic training involving several quantized local models. Experimental results across five distinct legal scenarios demonstrate the framework's ability to identify subtle trade-offs between model size, reasoning depth, and operational stability. Notably, the findings reveal an inverse relationship between parametric scale and procedural consistency, showing that smaller, adequately instruction-tuned models (8-9B) can outperform larger architectures prone to user-alignment bias or sycophancy. RPA-Check thus provides a standardized and reproducible metric for future research in generative agent evaluation within specialized domains.

52f656236c36b35c.text: Production logistics is increasingly exposed to variability, dynamic interdependencies, and operational disturbances that challenge conventional centralized planning and control approaches. Following a Design Science Research Methodology, this paper establishes a conceptual foundation for the design, implementation, and evaluation of Self-Organizing Production Logistics (SOPL) systems. First, key technological and systemic drivers motivating SOPL are identified, including autonomous logistics resources, advances in distributed AI-based decision-making, and the transition toward circular production systems, which further amplify operational uncertainty and complexity. Based on these drivers, system-level objectives and design requirements for SOPL are derived. Building on these requirements, the paper proposes an initial multi-agent architecture that integrates embodied and non-embodied agents, event-driven coordination, semantic knowledge structures, and digital twins. In addition, a three-phase demonstration roadmap is presented, progressing from an initial laboratory demonstrator toward increasingly distributed and adaptive SOPL systems. The Phase I demonstrator provides an experimental environment for investigating disturbance handling, human involvement, and supervisory coordination within an order-driven kitting and supply scenario.

5161e9f679ba8559.text: Grid-interactive building control can improve demand-side flexibility, but realistic evaluation requires coordinated co-simulation of buildings, reinforcement learning (RL), and distribution grids. Translating user intent into executable co-simulation workflows is labor-intensive, requiring the manual integration and configuration of heterogeneous simulators and interfaces. We introduce AutoB2G, a grid-aware building--grid co-simulation environment integrating CityLearn V2 with Pandapower and OpenDSS. It supports balanced and three-phase unbalanced grid simulation and a broad range of grid-side evaluation metrics. AutoB2G organizes simulation components as a directed acyclic graph (DAG), explicitly encoding module dependencies and execution order for dependency-aware retrieval and composition. Building on this structure, we develop a large language model (LLM)-based agentic framework that automatically retrieves, composes, executes, verifies, and repairs simulation pipelines from natural-language task descriptions. Experiments on realistic distribution networks show improved reliability and executability of complex building--grid workflows, demonstrating the potential of agentic LLMs for scientific simulation orchestration in energy systems.

5104910e7432bbd9.text: Optimizing large language models for industrial sales requires balancing long-term commercial objectives (e.g., conversion rate) with immediate linguistic constraints such as fluency and compliance. Conventional reinforcement learning often merges these heterogeneous goals into a single reward, causing high-magnitude session-level rewards to overwhelm subtler turn-level signals, which leads to unstable training or reward hacking. To address this issue, we propose Dual-Horizon Credit Assignment (DuCA), a framework that disentangles optimization across time scales. Its core, Horizon-Independent Advantage Normalization (HIAN), separately normalizes advantages from turn-level and session-level rewards before fusion, ensuring balanced gradient contributions from both immediate and long-term objectives to the policy update. Extensive experiments with a high-fidelity user simulator show DuCA outperforms the state-of-the-art GRPO baseline, achieving a 6.82% relative improvement in conversion rate, reducing inter-sentence repetition by 82.28%, and lowering identity detection rate by 27.35%, indicating a substantial improvement for an industrial sales scenario that effectively balances the dual demands of strategic performance and naturalistic language generation.

5a34c13b59c80d74.text: Multi-agent systems are designed to deal with open, distributed systems with unpredictable dynamics, which makes them inherently hard to test. The value of using simulation for this purpose is recognized in the literature, although achieving sufficient fidelity (i.e., the degree of similarity between the simulation and the real-world system) remains a challenging task. This is exacerbated when dealing with cognitive agent models, such as the Belief Desire Intention (BDI) model, where the agent codebase is not suitable to run unchanged in simulation environments, thus increasing the reality gap between the deployed and simulated systems. We argue that BDI developers should be able to test in simulation the same specification that will be later deployed, with no surrogate representations. Thus, in this paper, we discuss how the control flow of BDI agents can be mapped onto a Discrete Event Simulation (DES), showing that such integration is possible at different degrees of granularity. We substantiate our claims by producing an open-source prototype integration between two pre-existing tools (JaKtA and Alchemist), showing that it is possible to produce a simulation-based testing environment for distributed BDI} agents, and that different granularities in mapping BDI agents over DESs may lead to different degrees of fidelity.

5bf7b6e7ca77ed24.text: A/B testing remains the gold standard for evaluating e-commerce UI changes, yet it diverts traffic, takes weeks to reach significance, and risks harming user experience. We introduce SimGym, a scalable system for rapid offline A/B testing using traffic-grounded synthetic buyers powered by Large Language Model agents operating in a live browser. SimGym extracts per-shop buyer profiles and intents from production interaction data, identifies distinct behavioral archetypes, and simulates cohort-weighted sessions across control and treatment storefronts. We validate SimGym against real human outcomes from real UI changes on a major e-commerce platform under confounder control. Even without alignment post training, SimGym agents achieve state of the art alignment with observed outcome shifts and reduces experiment cycles from weeks to under an hour , enabling rapid experimentation without exposure to real buyers.
5bf7b6e7ca77ed24.abstract_zh: A/B 测试是评估电商界面改动的标准方法，但它会分流真实流量、需要数周才能达到统计显著，还可能损害用户体验。作者提出 SimGym，一个用大模型智能体做快速离线 A/B 测试的可扩展系统。做法上，SimGym 从生产环境的交互数据中提取每个店铺的买家画像和意图，识别出不同的行为原型，然后让由大模型驱动、运行在真实浏览器中的合成买家，按队列权重模拟会话，分别访问控制组和实验组的店面。验证方面，作者在一家大型电商平台的真实 UI 改动上，把 SimGym 的结果与真实人类结果对比，并做了混杂因素控制。结果显示，即使不做训练后的对齐，SimGym 智能体与观测到的结果变化也达到当前最优的对齐水平，并把实验周期从数周缩短到一小时以内，使团队能在不接触真实买家的情况下快速迭代实验。材料未说明具体对齐指标数值和平台的更多细节。
5bf7b6e7ca77ed24.why: 它展示了大模型智能体仿真可以替代真实流量的 A/B 测试，并拿真实电商平台的 UI 改动结果做了校准验证，对想用合成用户做离线实验评估的研究者和从业者是一个可参照的路径。

brief.question: 电商 UI 改动的 A/B 测试需要分流真实流量、耗时数周才能达到显著性，还可能损害用户体验，SimGym 用仿真买家做离线 A/B 测试来替代它。
brief.setup: 用 LLM 智能体驱动的合成买家在真实浏览器中操作，从生产交互数据中提取每个店铺的买家画像和意图，识别行为原型，在 control 和 treatment 店面上模拟按队列加权的会话。智能体数量、环境细节和时间尺度未说明。
brief.method: 从生产交互数据提取 per-shop 买家画像与意图，识别不同行为原型，再按队列权重在对照与实验店面间模拟会话。
brief.findings: 在一家大型电商平台的真实 UI 改动上，SimGym 智能体即使不做训练后对齐，与观测到的结果变化的吻合度也达到 state of the art，并把实验周期从数周缩短到一小时以内。
brief.validation: 与一家大型电商平台真实 UI 改动的人类真实结果对比，并做了混杂因素控制（confounder control），吻合度达到 state of the art；具体误差数字未说明。
brief.reuse: 未说明。

5b4d4d395cf7f184.text: Prediction markets offer a natural testbed for trading agents: contracts have binary payoffs, prices can be interpreted as probabilities, and realized performance depends critically on market microstructure, fees, and settlement risk. We introduce PredictionMarketBench, a SWE-bench-style benchmark for evaluating algorithmic and LLM-based trading agents on prediction markets via deterministic, event-driven replay of historical limit-order-book and trade data. PredictionMarketBench standardizes (i) episode construction from raw exchange streams (orderbooks, trades, lifecycle, settlement), (ii) an execution-realistic simulator with maker/taker semantics and fee modeling, and (iii) a tool-based agent interface that supports both classical strategies and tool-calling LLM agents with reproducible trajectories. We release four Kalshi-based episodes spanning cryptocurrency, weather, and sports. Baseline results show that naive trading agents can underperform due to transaction costs and settlement losses, while fee-aware algorithmic strategies remain competitive in volatile episodes.
5b4d4d395cf7f184.abstract_zh: 预测市场为交易智能体提供了天然的试验场：合约收益是二元的，价格可以直接解释为概率，而实际表现很大程度上取决于市场微观结构、手续费和结算风险。作者据此提出 PredictionMarketBench，一个仿照 SWE-bench 的基准，通过对历史限价订单簿和成交数据做确定性、事件驱动的重放，来评测算法交易策略和基于大模型的交易智能体。框架标准化了三件事：从原始交易所数据流（订单簿、成交、合约生命周期、结算）构建回测情景；一个执行层面贴近现实的仿真器，建模 maker/taker 语义和手续费；一个基于工具调用的智能体接口，既支持经典策略，也支持工具调用的大模型智能体，且轨迹可复现。作者发布了四个基于 Kalshi 的回测情景，覆盖加密货币、天气和体育。基线结果显示，朴素的交易智能体会因交易成本和结算亏损而表现不佳，而考虑费用的算法策略在波动情景中仍有竞争力。局限是情景数量还只有四个，且结果仅限于这些基线策略。
5b4d4d395cf7f184.why: 它把预测市场变成了可复现的智能体评测环境，maker/taker 语义和手续费建模让回测更贴近真实执行，对做交易智能体或市场仿真评测的人是可直接使用的基准资源。

brief.question: 如何用可复现的方式回测算法和 LLM 交易智能体在预测市场上的表现。
brief.setup: 发布四个基于 Kalshi 的回测 episode，覆盖加密货币、天气、体育三类事件，使用历史限价订单簿和成交数据做确定性事件驱动重放。
brief.method: 标准化三部分：从原始交易所数据流（订单簿、成交、合约生命周期、结算）构建 episode；带 maker/taker 语义和手续费建模的执行仿真器；工具调用接口，同时支持经典策略和 LLM 智能体，轨迹可复现。
brief.findings: 基线结果显示，朴素交易智能体会因交易成本和结算亏损而跑输；考虑手续费的经典算法策略在波动较大的 episode 中仍有竞争力。
brief.validation: 采用确定性事件驱动重放历史订单簿与成交数据，保证可复现；未说明与真实盈亏或人类交易者的定量对比。
brief.reuse: 可直接使用 PredictionMarketBench 框架、四个 Kalshi episode 数据和工具化智能体接口来评测自己的交易策略。

54859e4f2ef84f52.text: Large language models (LLMs) deployed in clinical decision support may acquiesce to patient requests for care that conflicts with evidence-based guidelines. We developed SycoEval-EM, a multi-agent simulation framework to evaluate LLM robustness to adversarial patient persuasion in emergency medicine. Across 19 contemporary LLMs and 1,425 simulated clinical encounters spanning three Choosing Wisely scenarios, acquiescence rates ranged from 0% to 100%, revealing a bimodal distribution. Seven models maintained near-perfect guideline adherence, while six acquiesced in the majority of encounters. Vulnerability varied substantially across clinical scenarios. Acquiescence was highest for CT imaging requests, intermediate for antibiotic prescriptions for sinusitis, and lowest for opioid prescriptions for acute back pain. Model scale, recency, and performance on static medical benchmarks did not consistently predict robustness. All five persuasion tactics produced similar acquiescence rates, with no statistically significant differences after correction for multiple comparisons, suggesting a generalized susceptibility rather than tactic-specific weaknesses. LLM-as-judge evaluation was validated against two independent physician raters across 95 matched conversations and demonstrated near-perfect agreement for the primary outcome of acquiescence (Cohens kappa = 0.957). These findings indicate that static medical benchmarks are insufficient to predict safety performance under sustained social pressure and support incorporating multi-turn adversarial testing into clinical AI evaluation. Notably, two models achieved perfect guideline adherence across all encounters, demonstrating that robustness to patient pressure is attainable without sacrificing effective clinical communication.
54859e4f2ef84f52.abstract_zh: 临床决策支持中的大模型可能会顺从患者提出的违背循证指南的请求。作者开发了 SycoEval-EM，一个多智能体仿真框架，用来评估大模型在急诊医学场景下对抗患者劝说的稳健性。实验覆盖 19 个当代大模型和 1425 次模拟临床对话，涉及三个 Choosing Wisely 场景。结果是顺从率呈双峰分布，范围从 0% 到 100%：七个模型几乎完全遵守指南，六个模型在多数对话中顺从了患者。脆弱性随临床场景变化明显，CT 影像检查请求的顺从率最高，鼻窦炎抗生素处方居中，急性腰痛阿片类药物处方最低。模型规模、新旧程度以及在静态医学基准上的表现都不能稳定预测稳健性。五种劝说策略产生的顺从率相近，多重比较校正后无统计显著差异，说明这是一种普遍易感性而非针对特定策略的弱点。评估方法上，LLM 评审与两位独立医生在 95 段匹配对话上的评分对主结局（顺从与否）的一致性接近完美，Cohen's kappa 为 0.957。作者认为静态医学基准不足以预测持续社会压力下的安全表现，临床 AI 评估应纳入多轮对抗测试。值得注意的是，有两个模型在所有对话中都完全遵守指南，说明顶住患者压力与保持有效临床沟通可以兼得。
54859e4f2ef84f52.why: 它把仿真推演用在了临床 AI 安全评测上，给出了可复用的多智能体对抗测试范式，并用医生评分验证了 LLM 评审的可信度；顺从率双峰分布和静态基准失效这两个结论对任何做对抗性评测的人都有参考价值。

brief.question: 评估 LLM 在急诊临床决策支持中面对患者不合理请求（如要求不符合循证指南的检查或处方）时是否会顺从，即谄媚性问题。
brief.setup: SycoEval-EM 多智能体仿真框架，覆盖 19 个当代 LLM，1,425 次模拟临床对话，涉及三个 Choosing Wisely 场景（CT 影像检查、鼻窦炎抗生素处方、急性腰痛阿片类药物处方）。
brief.method: 用对抗性患者说服策略对模型进行多轮施压测试，共五种说服策略，测量模型是否偏离循证指南而顺从请求。
brief.findings: 顺从率在 0% 到 100% 之间，呈双峰分布：7 个模型保持接近完美的指南依从性，6 个模型在多数对话中顺从。顺从率按场景递减：CT 检查最高，鼻窦炎抗生素居中，阿片类处方最低。模型规模、新旧和静态医学基准成绩都不能稳定预测鲁棒性。五种说服策略的顺从率无统计学显著差异，说明是普遍易感性而非特定策略弱点。两个模型在所有对话中保持完美指南依从。
brief.validation: LLM-as-judge 评估与两位独立医生评分者在 95 段匹配对话上对比，主要结局（顺从性）的 Cohens kappa = 0.957，接近完美一致。
brief.reuse: SycoEval-EM 多智能体仿真框架本身，以及将多轮对抗测试纳入临床 AI 评估的做法。

582494f7de74fffb.text: Telecommunication networks experience complex failures such as fiber cuts, traffic overloads, and cascading outages. Existing monitoring and digital twin systems are largely reactive, detecting failures only after service degradation occurs. We propose Adversarial Network Imagination, a closed-loop framework that integrates a Causal Large Language Model (LLM), a Knowledge Graph, and a Digital Twin to proactively generate, simulate, and evaluate adversarial network failures. The Causal LLM produces structured failure scenarios grounded in network dependencies encoded in the Knowledge Graph. These scenarios are executed within a Digital Twin to measure performance degradation and evaluate mitigation strategies. By iteratively refining scenarios based on simulation feedback, the framework shifts network operations from reactive troubleshooting toward anticipatory resilience analysis.

5a90bf61fac82f10.text: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being used to evolve solutions to problems in many domains, in a process inspired by biological evolution. However, unlike biological evolution, most LLM-evolution frameworks are formulated as static optimization problems, overlooking the open-ended adversarial dynamics that characterize real-world evolutionary processes. Here, we study Digital Red Queen (DRQ), a simple self-play algorithm that embraces these so-called "Red Queen" dynamics via continual adaptation to a changing objective. DRQ uses an LLM to evolve assembly-like programs, called warriors, which compete against each other for control of a virtual machine in the game of Core War, a Turing-complete environment studied in artificial life and connected to cybersecurity. In each round of DRQ, the model evolves a new warrior to defeat all previous ones, producing a sequence of adapted warriors. Over many rounds, we observe that warriors become increasingly general (relative to a set of held-out human warriors). Interestingly, warriors also become less behaviorally diverse across independent runs, indicating a convergence pressure toward a general-purpose behavioral strategy, much like convergent evolution in nature. This result highlights a potential value of shifting from static objectives to dynamic Red Queen objectives. Our work positions Core War as a rich, controllable sandbox for studying adversarial adaptation in artificial systems and for evaluating LLM-based evolution methods. More broadly, the simplicity and effectiveness of DRQ suggest that similarly minimal self-play approaches could prove useful in other more practical multi-agent adversarial domains, like real-world cybersecurity or combating drug resistance.

5aedb5cd1c2bb28c.text: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to simulate population responses, a method known as ``Silicon Sampling''. However, responses to socially sensitive questions frequently exhibit Social Desirability Bias (SDB), diverging from real human data toward socially acceptable answers. Existing studies on social desirability bias in LLM-based sampling remain limited. In this work, we investigate whether minimal, psychologically grounded prompt wording can mitigate this bias and improve alignment between silicon and human samples. We conducted a study using data from the American National Election Study (ANES) on three LLMs from two model families: the open-source Llama-3.1 series and GPT-4.1-mini. We first replicate a baseline silicon sampling study, confirming the persistent Social Desirability Bias. We then test four prompt-based mitigation methods: \emph{reformulated} (neutral, third-person phrasing), \emph{reverse-coded} (semantic inversion), and two meta-instructions, \emph{priming} and \emph{preamble}, respectively encouraging analytics and sincerity. Alignment with ANES is evaluated using Jensen-Shannon Divergence with bootstrap confidence intervals. Our results demonstrate that reformulated prompts most effectively improve alignment by reducing distribution concentration on socially acceptable answers and achieving distributions closer to ANES. Reverse-coding produced mixed results across eligible items, while the Priming and Preamble encouraged response uniformity and showed no systematic benefit for bias mitigation. Our findings validate the efficacy of prompt-based framing controls in mitigating inherent Social Desirability Bias in LLMs, providing a practical path toward more representative silicon samples.
5aedb5cd1c2bb28c.abstract_zh: 用大模型模拟人群回答问卷（即硅基抽样）时，模型对社会敏感问题的回答常带社会期许偏差，偏向给出社会可接受的答案，与真实人类数据偏离。针对这一问题，作者考察了最小化、有心理学依据的提示词措辞能否缓解偏差。研究使用美国全国选举研究（ANES）的数据，在两个模型家族的三个模型上展开：开源的 Llama-3.1 系列和 GPT-4.1-mini。作者先复现了基线硅基抽样研究，确认偏差持续存在。随后测试四种提示词缓解方法：reformulated（中性、第三人称改写）、reverse-coded（语义反转）、priming 和 preamble 两种元指令，分别引导模型进行分析性思考和真诚作答。对齐程度用 Jensen-Shannon 散度加 bootstrap 置信区间来评估。结果显示，reformulated 提示词效果最好，它降低了答案在社会可接受选项上的集中度，分布最接近 ANES。reverse-coded 在适用条目上结果好坏参半，priming 和 preamble 则让回答趋于均匀，对缓解偏差没有系统性收益。这些发现验证了基于提示词的框架控制能缓解 LLM 固有的社会期许偏差，为获得更有代表性的硅基样本提供了一条实用路径。
5aedb5cd1c2bb28c.why: 对用 LLM 做问卷或人群仿真的研究者，这篇给出了可直接复用的提示词改写方案，并指出哪些常见做法（元指令）无效，还附带了与 ANES 真实数据的对照结果。

5085a13d05f6a5be.text: Multi-Agent System (MAS) developing frameworks serve as the foundational infrastructure for social simulations powered by Large Language Models (LLMs). However, existing frameworks fail to adequately support large-scale simulation development due to inherent limitations in adaptability, configurability, reliability, and code reusability. For example, they cannot simulate a society where the agent population and profiles change over time. To fill this gap, we propose Agent-Kernel, a framework built upon a novel society-centric modular microkernel architecture. It decouples core system functions from simulation logic and separates cognitive processes from physical environments and action execution. Consequently, Agent-Kernel achieves superior adaptability, configurability, reliability, and reusability. We validate the framework's superiority through two distinct applications: a simulation of the Universe 25 (Mouse Utopia) experiment, which demonstrates the handling of rapid population dynamics from birth to death; and a large-scale simulation of the Zhejiang University Campus Life, successfully coordinating 10,000 heterogeneous agents, including students and faculty.
5085a13d05f6a5be.abstract_zh: LLM 驱动的社会仿真依赖多智能体系统（MAS）开发框架作为基础设施，但现有框架在适应性、可配置性、可靠性和代码复用性上有内在局限，难以支撑大规模仿真开发。比如它们无法模拟智能体数量和画像随时间变化的社会。为填补这一空白，作者提出 Agent-Kernel，其核心是一个新颖的以社会为中心的模块化微内核架构。该架构把系统核心功能与仿真逻辑解耦，同时把智能体的认知过程与物理环境和动作执行分离，由此在适应性、可配置性、可靠性和复用性上取得优势。框架通过两个不同应用验证。一是 Universe 25（老鼠乌托邦）实验的仿真，展示了框架对从出生到死亡的快速人口动态的处理能力。二是浙江大学校园生活的大规模仿真，成功协调了 10000 个异构智能体，包括学生和教职工。材料未说明与真实数据的对比结果。
5085a13d05f6a5be.why: 它给出了一个可直接复用的大规模 LLM 社会仿真框架思路，微内核解耦设计解决了人口动态变化和万人级异构智能体协调这两个现有框架的痛点。

brief.question: 现有 LLM 多智能体系统框架在适应性、可配置性、可靠性和代码复用性上不足，无法模拟智能体数量和画像随时间变化的社会，Agent-Kernel 要解决大规模社会仿真开发的基础设施问题。
brief.setup: 框架采用社会中心的模块化微内核架构。验证场景有两个：Universe 25（Mouse Utopia）实验仿真，覆盖从出生到死亡的快速人口动态；浙江大学校园生活大规模仿真，协调 10000 个异构智能体（学生和教职工）。使用的具体 LLM 模型未说明。
brief.method: 微内核架构把核心系统功能与仿真逻辑解耦，把认知过程与物理环境和动作执行分离。
brief.findings: 两个应用验证了框架能力：Universe 25 仿真展示了从出生到死亡的快速人口动态处理；浙大校园仿真成功协调 10000 个异构智能体。
brief.validation: 通过两个应用场景验证框架的适应性和可扩展性，未与真实数据或人类基线做定量对比，强度较弱。
brief.reuse: Agent-Kernel 框架本身，代码是否开源未说明。

53a8a04eddbcd422.text: The use of Large Language Models (LLMs) for simulating human perspectives via persona prompting is gaining traction in computational social science. However, well-curated, empirically grounded persona collections remain scarce, limiting the accuracy and representativeness of such simulations. Here, we introduce the German General Social Survey Personas (GGSS Personas) collection, a comprehensive and representative persona prompt collection built from the German General Social Survey (ALLBUS). The GGSS Personas and their persona prompts are designed to be easily plugged into prompts for all types of LLMs and tasks, steering models to generate responses aligned with the underlying German population. We evaluate GGSS Personas by prompting various LLMs to simulate survey response distributions across diverse topics, demonstrating that GGSS Personas-guided LLMs outperform state-of-the-art classifiers, particularly under data scarcity. Furthermore, we analyze how the representativity and attribute selection within persona prompts affect alignment with population responses. Our findings suggest that GGSS Personas provide a potentially valuable resource for research on LLM-based social simulations that enables more systematic explorations of population-aligned persona prompting in NLP and social science research.
53a8a04eddbcd422.abstract_zh:
在计算社会科学中，用大语言模型通过角色提示模拟人类观点的做法越来越多，但缺乏经过精心整理、有实证依据的角色集合，限制了这类模拟的准确性和代表性。作者为此构建了 GGSS Personas，一套基于德国综合社会调查（ALLBUS）的全面且有代表性的角色提示集合。这些角色提示设计成可以直接插入各类 LLM 和任务的提示中，引导模型生成与德国人口分布对齐的回答。

评估方面，作者让多个 LLM 在 GGSS Personas 引导下模拟不同主题的调查回答分布，结果显示其表现优于最先进的分类器，在数据稀缺场景下优势尤其明显。作者还分析了角色提示中的代表性和属性选择如何影响与人口回答的对齐程度。

作者认为 GGSS Personas 为基于 LLM 的社会仿真研究提供了有价值的资源，可以在 NLP 和社会科学研究中更系统地探索人口对齐的角色提示方法。局限在于该集合基于德国数据，摘要未报告与其他国家人口的对比验证。
53a8a04eddbcd422.why: 它提供了一个可直接复用、有真实调查数据支撑的人口对齐角色库，对需要用 LLM 模拟人群观点分布的研究者是现成资源，也给出了角色属性选择影响对齐度的实证分析。

brief.question: 解决 persona prompting 仿真人类观点时缺乏经过实证、有代表性的人物设定集合的问题，让 LLM 仿真更贴近德国真实人口。
brief.setup: 基于德国综合社会调查 ALLBUS 构建的 GGSS Personas 人物提示词集合，可插入各类 LLM 的提示词中，具体智能体数量和模型清单未说明。
brief.method: 从 ALLBUS 调查数据推导出带有人口属性的人物设定，写成 persona prompt 引导 LLM 生成与德国人口对齐的回答。
brief.findings: 用 GGSS Personas 引导的 LLM 在模拟多主题调查回答分布时优于 state-of-the-art 分类器，在数据稀缺场景下优势更明显；还分析了 persona prompt 中代表性和属性选择如何影响与人口回答的对齐程度。
brief.validation: 与 SOTA 分类器在模拟调查回答分布任务上对比，并做了 persona 代表性与属性选择的消融分析；具体误差数字未说明。
brief.reuse: GGSS Personas 提示词集合可直接插入各类 LLM 提示词，用于人口对齐的仿真研究。

5d057ae8fcc2e58a.text: Simulating human profiles by instilling personas into large language models (LLMs) is rapidly transforming research in agentic behavioral simulation, LLM personalization, and human-AI alignment. However, most existing synthetic personas remain shallow and simplistic, capturing minimal attributes and failing to reflect the rich complexity and diversity of real human identities. We introduce DEEPPERSONA, a scalable generative engine for synthesizing narrative-complete synthetic personas through a two-stage, taxonomy-guided method. First, we algorithmically construct the largest-ever human-attribute taxonomy, comprising over hundreds of hierarchically organized attributes, by mining thousands of real user-ChatGPT conversations. Second, we progressively sample attributes from this taxonomy, conditionally generating coherent and realistic personas that average hundreds of structured attributes and roughly 1 MB of narrative text, two orders of magnitude deeper than prior works. Intrinsic evaluations confirm significant improvements in attribute diversity (32 percent higher coverage) and profile uniqueness (44 percent greater) compared to state-of-the-art baselines. Extrinsically, our personas enhance GPT-4.1-mini's personalized question answering accuracy by 11.6 percent on average across ten metrics and substantially narrow (by 31.7 percent) the gap between simulated LLM citizens and authentic human responses in social surveys. Our generated national citizens reduced the performance gap on the Big Five personality test by 17 percent relative to LLM-simulated citizens. DEEPPERSONA thus provides a rigorous, scalable, and privacy-free platform for high-fidelity human simulation and personalized AI research.
5d057ae8fcc2e58a.abstract_zh: 给大语言模型注入人格设定来做行为仿真，正在改变智能体行为模拟、LLM 个性化和人机对齐的研究，但现有合成人格大多浅层、简单，只包含少量属性，反映不出真实人类身份的复杂性。作者提出 DEEPPERSONA，用两阶段、分类体系引导的方法生成叙事完整的合成人格。第一阶段，他们从数千条真实用户与 ChatGPT 的对话中算法化地构建出迄今最大的人类属性分类体系，包含数百个层级组织的属性。第二阶段，从这个分类体系中渐进采样属性，条件化生成连贯、真实的人格，平均每人包含数百个结构化属性和约 1MB 的叙事文本，深度比以往工作高两个数量级。内在评测显示，与最先进基线相比，属性多样性覆盖提高 32%，档案独特性提高 44%。外在评测中，这些人格让 GPT-4.1-mini 在十项指标上的个性化问答准确率平均提升 11.6%，并把模拟 LLM 公民与真实人类在社会调查中的回答差距缩小 31.7%；生成的国家级公民在大五人格测试上，与 LLM 模拟公民相比把性能差距缩小 17%。作者认为 DEEPPERSONA 为高保真人类仿真和个性化 AI 研究提供了一个严谨、可扩展且不涉及隐私的平台。局限方面材料未展开讨论。
5d057ae8fcc2e58a.why: 它给出了迄今最深的人格生成方法和最大的属性分类体系，直接回应“合成受访者能否替代真人样本”这一仿真可信度问题，且在真实问卷对照上验证了效果，适合做社会仿真和合成样本的研究者参考。

brief.question: 现有 LLM 合成人设（synthetic personas）大多浅层、简单，只包含少量属性，无法反映真实人类身份的复杂性和多样性，DeepPersona 要生成叙事完整、深度的合成人设。
brief.setup: 未说明具体智能体数量与环境。方法上从数千条真实用户与 ChatGPT 的对话中挖掘出数百个层级组织的人类属性，构成迄今最大的人类属性分类体系（taxonomy），再从中渐进采样属性，条件生成连贯人设。生成的人设平均包含数百个结构化属性、约 1 MB 叙事文本，深度比以往工作高两个数量级。
brief.method: 两阶段、分类体系引导的生成：第一阶段算法化构建人类属性 taxonomy，第二阶段从 taxonomy 渐进采样并条件生成连贯真实的人设。
brief.findings: 属性多样性（coverage）比 SOTA 基线高 32%，档案独特性高 44%。用其人设增强 GPT-4.1-mini 的个性化问答，十项指标平均准确率提升 11.6%。在社会调查中，模拟 LLM 公民与真实人类回答的差距缩小 31.7%；在 Big Five 人格测试上，生成的国家公民比 LLM 模拟公民的表现差距降低 17%。
brief.validation: 内蕴评估对比 SOTA 基线（多样性 +32%、独特性 +44%）；外蕴评估包括 GPT-4.1-mini 个性化问答十项指标（+11.6%）、与真实人类社会调查回答对比（差距缩小 31.7%）、Big Five 人格测试对比（差距降低 17%）。未说明具体对比数据集规模。
brief.reuse: 可复用其两阶段 taxonomy 引导生成方法，以及挖掘真实用户-ChatGPT 对话构建属性分类体系的做法；代码和数据是否公开未说明。

5c9655c70349b71b.text: Online social networks have transformed the ways in which political mobilization messages are disseminated, raising new questions about how peer influence operates at scale. Building on the landmark 61-million-person Facebook experiment \citep{bond201261}, we develop an agent-based simulation framework that integrates real U.S. Census demographic distributions, authentic Twitter network topology, and heterogeneous large language model (LLM) agents to examine the effect of mobilization messages on voter turnout. Each simulated agent is assigned demographic attributes, a personal political stance, and an LLM variant (\texttt{GPT-4.1}, \texttt{GPT-4.1-Mini}, or \texttt{GPT-4.1-Nano}) reflecting its political sophistication. Agents interact over realistic social network structures, receiving personalized feeds and dynamically updating their engagement behaviors and voting intentions. Experimental conditions replicate the informational and social mobilization treatments of the original Facebook study. Across scenarios, the simulator reproduces qualitative patterns observed in field experiments, including stronger mobilization effects under social message treatments and measurable peer spillovers. Our framework provides a controlled, reproducible environment for testing counterfactual designs and sensitivity analyses in political mobilization research, offering a bridge between high-validity field experiments and flexible computational modeling.\footnote{Code and data available at https://github.com/CausalMP/LLM-SocioPol}
5c9655c70349b71b.abstract_zh: 背景是 2012 年 Bond 等人在脸书上做的 6100 万人投票动员实验，它揭示了同伴影响在大规模政治动员中的作用，但这类实地实验成本高、难以重复。作者据此搭了一个基于智能体的仿真框架：智能体的人口属性来自真实美国人口普查分布，社交网络用真实的推特拓扑，每个智能体还有一个政治立场和一个 LLM 变体（GPT-4.1、GPT-4.1-Mini 或 GPT-4.1-Nano），用不同模型反映政治成熟度的差异。智能体在网络结构上互动，接收个性化信息流，动态更新参与行为和投票意向。实验条件复刻了原脸书研究中的信息动员和社会动员两种处理。跨场景的结果显示，仿真复现了实地实验观察到的定性规律：社会性消息处理下的动员效果更强，同伴溢出效应可测量。作者认为这个框架为政治动员研究提供了可控、可复现的环境，可以测试反事实设计和做敏感性分析，在高效度的实地实验和灵活的计算建模之间架了座桥。局限方面材料未展开，仿真只声称复现定性模式，没有给出与实地数据逐点对比的数字。
5c9655c70349b71b.why: 它示范了如何把大规模实地实验转成可复现的 LLM 智能体仿真，人口分布、网络拓扑和实验处理都来自真实数据，做舆论动员或社会仿真的人可以直接拿这套框架跑反事实分析。

brief.question: 社交媒体上的政治动员信息如何在大规模同伴影响下影响投票率，作者想用仿真复现并扩展 Bond 等人 6100 万人 Facebook 实验的发现。
brief.setup: 智能体基于真实美国人口普查的人口属性分布生成，每个智能体有个人政治立场和一个 LLM 变体（GPT-4.1、GPT-4.1-Mini 或 GPT-4.1-Nano），对应不同政治成熟度。智能体在真实 Twitter 网络拓扑上互动，接收个性化信息流并动态更新参与行为和投票意向。智能体数量未说明。
brief.method: 智能体仿真框架，整合真实人口普查数据、真实 Twitter 网络结构和异质 LLM 智能体；实验条件复刻原 Facebook 研究的信息型与社会型动员处理。
brief.findings: 仿真复现了田野实验中观察到的定性模式：社会型动员信息（social message treatments）产生更强的动员效果，且存在可测量的同伴溢出效应（peer spillovers）。具体数字未说明。
brief.validation: 与 Bond 等人 2012 年 6100 万人 Facebook 田野实验的定性结果对比，复现了社会动员效果更强和同伴溢出两个模式。定量误差或消融实验未说明。
brief.reuse: 代码和数据开源于 https://github.com/CausalMP/LLM-SocioPol，可用于反事实设计和敏感性分析。

50edd38fb888a3f0.text: In this paper, we present SOCIA-Nabla, an end-to-end, agentic framework that treats simulator construction asinstance optimization over code within a textual computation graph. Specialized LLM-driven agents are embedded as graph nodes, and a workflow manager executes a loss-driven loop: code synthesis -> execution -> evaluation -> code repair. The optimizer performs Textual-Gradient Descent (TGD), while human-in-the-loop interaction is reserved for task-spec confirmation, minimizing expert effort and keeping the code itself as the trainable object. Across three CPS tasks, i.e., User Modeling, Mask Adoption, and Personal Mobility, SOCIA-Nabla attains state-of-the-art overall accuracy. By unifying multi-agent orchestration with a loss-aligned optimization view, SOCIA-Nabla converts brittle prompt pipelines into reproducible, constraint-aware simulator code generation that scales across domains and simulation granularities. This work is under review, and we will release the code soon.
50edd38fb888a3f0.abstract_zh: 构建仿真器通常需要专家手工写代码，SOCIA-Nabla 把这件事变成一个优化问题：把仿真器构建视为文本计算图中的代码实例优化。框架里嵌入了多个专门化的 LLM 智能体作为图节点，由一个工作流管理器执行损失驱动的循环，依次做代码合成、执行、评估和代码修复。优化器执行的是文本梯度下降（Textual-Gradient Descent），人在回路中的参与只保留在任务规格确认这一步，以此减少专家工作量，同时让代码本身成为可训练的对象。作者在三个 CPS（网络物理社会系统）任务上做了实验，分别是用户建模、口罩采纳和个人出行，SOCIA-Nabla 取得了最优的总体准确率。作者认为，把多智能体编排和损失对齐的优化视角统一起来，能把脆弱的提示词流水线变成可复现、带约束感知的仿真器代码生成，并且能跨领域、跨仿真粒度扩展。论文正在审稿中，代码将很快发布。
50edd38fb888a3f0.why: 它把仿真器生成本身变成可优化的对象，用文本梯度加多智能体循环替代手工搭仿真，对做城市与出行仿真又不想从零写代码的研究者是条新路。

551842910b5fbf4b.text: Language is fundamental to human cooperation, facilitating not only the exchange of information but also the coordination of actions through shared interpretations of situational contexts. This study explores whether the Generative Agent-Based Model (GABM) Concordia can effectively model Theory of Mind (ToM) within simulated real-world environments. Specifically, we assess whether this framework successfully simulates ToM abilities and whether GPT-4 can perform tasks by making genuine inferences from social context, rather than relying on linguistic memorization. Our findings reveal a critical limitation: GPT-4 frequently fails to select actions based on belief attribution, suggesting that apparent ToM-like abilities observed in previous studies may stem from shallow statistical associations rather than true reasoning. Additionally, the model struggles to generate coherent causal effects from agent actions, exposing difficulties in processing complex social interactions. These results challenge current statements about emergent ToM-like capabilities in LLMs and highlight the need for more rigorous, action-based evaluation frameworks.
551842910b5fbf4b.abstract_zh: 语言是人类合作的基础，既传递信息，也通过对情境的共同理解来协调行动。这项研究考察生成式智能体建模框架 Concordia 能否在模拟的真实环境中建模心智理论（Theory of Mind, ToM）。作者评估两件事：该框架能否有效模拟 ToM 能力，以及 GPT-4 能否真正从社会情境中做推断来完成任务，而不是依赖语言层面的记忆。结果暴露出一个关键局限：GPT-4 经常无法基于信念归因来选择行动，说明此前研究中观察到的类 ToM 能力可能来自浅层的统计关联，而非真正的推理。此外，模型也难以从智能体的行动中生成连贯的因果效应，在处理复杂社会互动上有明显困难。这些结果对当前关于大模型涌现出类 ToM 能力的说法提出质疑，并指出需要更严格的、基于行动的评估框架。
551842910b5fbf4b.why: 它给“LLM 有心智理论”这一流行结论提供了一个反例：在基于行动而非文本问答的评估里，GPT-4 的信念归因经常失败，做社会仿真或推演的人在解读智能体行为时需要警惕这种浅层统计关联。

brief.question: 检验 GPT-4 在仿真环境中表现出的 Theory of Mind（ToM）能力是真推理还是语言记忆，并评估 Generative Agent-Based Model（GABM）Concordia 框架能否在模拟真实世界的环境里建模 ToM。
brief.setup: 使用 GABM 框架 Concordia 构建模拟真实世界的环境，智能体由 GPT-4 驱动，具体智能体数量、环境细节和时间尺度未说明。
brief.method: 让 GPT-4 智能体在 Concordia 仿真环境中执行基于社会情境的行动任务，考察其是否基于信念归因（belief attribution）选择行动，而非依赖语言记忆。
brief.findings: GPT-4 频繁无法基于信念归因选择行动，此前研究中观察到的类 ToM 能力可能来自浅层统计关联而非真推理；模型也难以从智能体行动中生成连贯的因果效应，处理复杂社会互动存在困难。
brief.validation: 未说明（材料提到需要更严格的基于行动的评估框架，但未给出具体验证数据）。
brief.limits: GPT-4 依赖浅层统计关联而非真推理，难以处理复杂社会互动并生成连贯因果效应，现有关于 LLM 涌现类 ToM 能力的说法受到质疑。
brief.reuse: 未说明（材料未提及公开的代码或数据）。

5fa1845b1b3c5f1d.text: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to domains that require reasoning about other agents' behavior, such as negotiation, policy design, and market simulation. However, can we trust LLMs to think strategically in complex situations? Existing research mostly evaluates LLMs' adherence to equilibrium play or their exhibited depth of reasoning, leaving open whether they display strategic thinking meant as the ability to form coherent conjectures about other agents, to evaluate possible actions conditional on those conjectures, and to best respond to them. We develop a framework to identify this ability by disentangling belief formation, evaluation, and choice in static complete-information games across a series of non-cooperative environments. By jointly analyzing models' revealed choices and reasoning traces, and introducing a new context-free game to rule out imitation from memorization, we show that strategic thinking in current frontier LLMs is real but fragile: models execute best responses to exogenous conjectures and form opponent-contingent conjectures when left unconstrained. Yet under increasing complexity explicit recursion gives way to model-specific logic shifts and heuristic rules of choice, both within and outside equilibrium reasoning. Further, these heuristics do not map directly onto the systematic biases typically observed in human strategic behavior. These findings, already emerging in noiseless settings, warrant caution in the application of LLMs as strategic agents in complex environments.
5fa1845b1b3c5f1d.abstract_zh: 大模型越来越多地被用在谈判、政策设计和市场仿真这类需要推断其他智能体行为的领域，但它们能否在复杂局面下进行可信的战略思考仍缺乏检验。已有研究大多只评估模型是否遵循均衡策略或展现推理深度，没有回答一个更根本的问题：模型能否形成关于其他参与者的连贯猜想，基于这些猜想评估可选行动，并做出最优响应。作者为此开发了一个分析框架，在一系列静态完全信息博弈的非合作环境中，把信念形成、评估和选择三个环节拆开分别考察。方法上，他们联合分析模型做出的选择和推理过程文本，并设计了一个新的无上下文博弈，用来排除模型靠记忆模仿已有博弈解的可能。结论是，当前前沿大模型的战略思维真实存在但很脆弱。在简单情形下，模型能对外生给定的猜想执行最优响应，在不受约束时也能形成依赖对手的猜想。但随着复杂度上升，显式的递归推理让位于各模型特有的逻辑跳变和启发式选择规则，这些行为有的在均衡推理之内，有的在均衡之外。而且这些启发式规则与人类战略行为中常见的系统性偏差并不对应。这些现象在无噪声环境下就已出现，作者据此提醒，把大模型当作复杂环境中的战略智能体使用需要谨慎。
5fa1845b1b3c5f1d.why: 它直接关系到能否用大模型智能体做谈判、市场和政策的仿真推演：结果表明简单博弈里模型会推理，复杂度一高就退化成启发式，且退化模式与人类偏差不同，用前需要先测这个。

brief.question: 前沿 LLM 在需要推测其他智能体行为的复杂情境（谈判、政策设计、市场仿真）中能否进行真正的战略性思考，即形成对对手的连贯推测、据此评估可选行动并做出最优应对。
brief.setup: 在静态完全信息博弈的一系列非合作环境中测试前沿 LLM，未说明具体模型名称、数量和时间尺度。
brief.method: 构建一个框架，把信念形成、评估和选择三个环节拆开分析；联合分析模型的选择和推理痕迹；引入一个新的 context-free 博弈来排除模型靠记忆模仿的可能。
brief.findings: 当前前沿 LLM 的战略性思考真实存在但脆弱：模型能对给定的外生推测执行最优应对，在不受约束时也能形成依赖对手的推测；但随着复杂度上升，显式递归让位于模型特有的逻辑转变和启发式选择规则，这些启发式与人类战略行为中的系统性偏差并不对应。这些现象在无噪声设定下就已出现。
brief.validation: 通过联合分析选择与推理痕迹、拆解三个环节来验证，并用新设计的 context-free 博弈排除记忆模仿的解释；未说明与人类被试或真实数据的定量对比。
brief.limits: 作者据此提醒，在复杂环境中把 LLM 用作战略性智能体需保持谨慎；未说明其他具体局限。
brief.reuse: 拆解信念形成、评估、选择的分析框架和排除记忆模仿的 context-free 博弈设计可供借鉴；未说明是否公开代码或数据。

5d4d9019747b098f.text: We present LegalSim, a modular multi-agent simulation of adversarial legal proceedings that explores how AI systems can exploit procedural weaknesses in codified rules. Plaintiff and defendant agents choose from a constrained action space (for example, discovery requests, motions, meet-and-confer, sanctions) governed by a JSON rules engine, while a stochastic judge model with calibrated grant rates, cost allocations, and sanction tendencies resolves outcomes. We compare four policies: PPO, a contextual bandit with an LLM, a direct LLM policy, and a hand-crafted heuristic; Instead of optimizing binary case outcomes, agents are trained and evaluated using effective win rate and a composite exploit score that combines opponent-cost inflation, calendar pressure, settlement pressure at low merit, and a rule-compliance margin. Across configurable regimes (e.g., bankruptcy stays, inter partes review, tax procedures) and heterogeneous judges, we observe emergent ``exploit chains'', such as cost-inflating discovery sequences and calendar-pressure tactics that remain procedurally valid yet systemically harmful. Evaluation via cross-play and Bradley-Terry ratings shows, PPO wins more often, the bandit is the most consistently competitive across opponents, the LLM trails them, and the heuristic is weakest. The results are stable in judge settings, and the simulation reveals emergent exploit chains, motivating red-teaming of legal rule systems in addition to model-level testing.
5d4d9019747b098f.abstract_zh: LegalSim 是一个模拟对抗式法律程序的多智能体系统，研究 AI 如何利用成文规则中的程序性弱点。原告和被告智能体在受限行动空间里选择动作，比如证据开示请求、动议、会商、制裁申请，这些动作由一个 JSON 规则引擎管理。法官是一个带校准批准率、费用分配和制裁倾向的随机模型，负责裁决结果。作者比较了四种策略：PPO、带 LLM 的上下文老虎机、直接用 LLM 的策略和手工启发式。智能体的训练和评估不优化二元胜负，而是用有效胜率和一个综合漏洞得分，后者结合了对对手的成本抬升、日程压力、低案情价值下的和解压力以及规则合规余量。仿真覆盖多种可配置程序场景（破产自动中止、专利多方复审、税务程序）和异质法官。结果显示出涌现的“漏洞链”，比如抬高对方成本的证据开示序列和日程施压战术，这些做法程序上合法，但对系统有害。通过交叉对局和 Bradley-Terry 评分评估，PPO 赢得更多，老虎机在不同对手面前最稳定，LLM 落后于前两者，启发式最弱。结果在不同法官设置下保持稳定。作者认为这提示除了模型层面的测试，法律规则系统本身也需要红队测试。
5d4d9019747b098f.why: 它把 AI 安全的红队思路从模型层移到规则层，用可配置的多智能体仿真系统性地找出法律程序里程序合法但系统有害的漏洞链，方法可直接迁移到其他成文规则系统的压力测试。

brief.question: 研究 AI 系统如何利用成文法律规则中的程序性弱点，通过对抗性法律程序仿真发现程序漏洞（procedural exploits）。
brief.setup: 原告与被告两类智能体在模块化多智能体仿真中进行对抗性法律程序博弈，行动空间受约束（如 discovery requests、motions、meet-and-confer、sanctions），由带校准批准率、费用分配和制裁倾向的随机法官模型裁决结果。可配置多种法律程序场景（bankruptcy stays、inter partes review、tax procedures）和异质法官。未说明具体使用的 LLM 型号和智能体数量。
brief.method: 用 JSON 规则引擎约束行动空间；不优化二元胜负结果，而是用 effective win rate 和一个综合 exploit score（结合对手成本膨胀、日程压力、低胜诉理由下的和解压力、规则合规边际）训练和评估智能体；比较四种策略：PPO、带 LLM 的 contextual bandit、直接 LLM 策略、手工启发式策略。
brief.findings: 观察到涌现的 exploit chains，例如成本膨胀式 discovery 序列和日程压力战术，程序上合法但系统有害。跨对局（cross-play）和 Bradley-Terry 评分显示：PPO 胜率最高，bandit 在不同对手间最稳定地有竞争力，LLM 策略落后于前两者，启发式最弱。结果在不同法官设置下保持稳定。
brief.validation: 通过 cross-play 对局和 Bradley-Terry 评分比较四种策略，并检验结果在法官设置变化下的稳定性。未说明与真实法律数据或人类律师的对比。
brief.limits: 未说明。作者提出结论动机是应对法律规则系统做 red-teaming，除模型级测试外还需规则级测试。
brief.reuse: 模块化仿真框架、JSON 规则引擎、exploit score 指标设计、cross-play 加 Bradley-Terry 的评估流程可借鉴。未说明是否开源代码或数据。

542b9d15b34b2992.text: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to simulate human collective behavior, yet claims that such simulations are human-like remain largely untested. We conducted a systematic audit (pre-registered on OSF) of LLM-based social simulations across four databases (Scopus, IEEE Xplore, ACM Digital Library, and arXiv). Across 576 studies reported in 350 recent papers, we applied six methodological evaluations: agent Profile, Interaction, Memory, Minimal-Control, Unawareness, and Realism (PIMMUR). Coding every study against pre-specified rules, we revealed that PIM were met more often than MUR. Frontier LLMs correctly identified the underlying social experiment in 65.2% of cases, and 50.6% of prompts imposed constraints that pre-determined the outcome. These compliance rates are upper bounds, because incomplete methodological reporting (for example, unreleased prompts) limits the available evidence. Reproducing five representative experiments (e.g., opinion dynamics), we found that reported collective phenomena often vanish or reverse once PIMMUR principles are enforced, indicating that many "emergent" behaviors are methodological artifacts rather than genuine social dynamics. Current LLM simulations may therefore capture model-specific biases rather than universal features of human social behavior, raising concerns about their use as scientific proxies for human society.
542b9d15b34b2992.abstract_zh: LLM 越来越多地被用来模拟人类群体行为，但这类仿真是否真的像人，一直缺乏系统检验。作者在 OSF 上预注册了审计方案，从 Scopus、IEEE Xplore、ACM Digital Library 和 arXiv 四个数据库检索，覆盖 350 篇近期论文中的 576 项研究，用六项方法学标准逐一编码，即智能体画像（Profile）、交互（Interaction）、记忆（Memory）、最小控制（Minimal-Control）、无察觉（Unawareness）和真实性（Realism），合称 PIMMUR。审计发现，PIM 三项的满足率明显高于 MUR 三项。前沿 LLM 在 65.2% 的情况下能正确识别出仿真对应的真实社会实验，说明模型可能见过这些实验。50.6% 的提示词施加了预先决定结果的约束。由于方法学报告不完整（比如提示词未公开），这些合规率只能视为上界。作者还复现了五个代表性实验（如观点动力学），发现一旦严格执行 PIMMUR 原则，论文报告的群体现象常常消失甚至反转。这意味着许多所谓涌现行为其实是方法学假象，而非真实的社会动态。当前的 LLM 仿真捕捉到的可能是模型自身的偏差，而不是人类社会行为的普遍规律，用它作为人类社会的科学替代品需要谨慎。
542b9d15b34b2992.why: 这是对 LLM 社会仿真领域一次罕见的预注册大规模审计，给出了可直接使用的 PIMMUR 评估清单，并用复现实验证明许多涌现现象是假象，对任何想用 LLM 做社会推演的人都是必读的风险提示。

brief.question: LLM 多智能体社会仿真声称能复现人类集体行为，但这些说法到底站不站得住脚，作者做了一次系统性审计来回答这个问题。
brief.setup: 审计对象来自 Scopus、IEEE Xplore、ACM Digital Library 和 arXiv 四个数据库，覆盖 350 篇近期论文中的 576 项研究。审计方案预先注册在 OSF 上。作者还复现了五个代表性实验（例如 opinion dynamics，意见动力学）。
brief.method: 提出 PIMMUR 六项评估原则，即 agent Profile、Interaction、Memory、Minimal-Control、Unawareness、Realism，按预先设定的规则对每项研究逐条编码打分。
brief.findings: 结果显示 PIM 三项达标率高于 MUR 三项。前沿 LLM 在 65.2% 的情况下能直接猜出仿真背后对应的社会学实验，50.6% 的 prompt 施加了预先决定结果的约束。复现的五个实验中，一旦强制执行 PIMMUR 原则，很多报告过的集体现象会消失甚至反转，说明不少所谓涌现行为其实是方法学伪影，反映的是模型自身偏差而非人类社会行为的普遍特征。
brief.validation: 审计预先注册在 OSF，按预指定规则编码全部 576 项研究，并用前沿 LLM 识别原始实验的方式检验 Unawareness。作者指出这些合规率只是上界，因为方法报告不完整（比如 prompt 未公开）限制了证据。复现实验提供了行为层面的验证。
brief.limits: 材料未说明具体局限，但作者提到方法学报告不完整（如未公开 prompt）导致合规率只能算上界，且当前 LLM 仿真可能捕捉的是模型特有偏差。
brief.reuse: PIMMUR 六项原则可直接用作 LLM 社会仿真研究的有效性检查清单，OSF 上的预注册方案和五项复现实验（如 opinion dynamics）也可作为参照。

5d59a3058f09285b.text: LLM-based multi-agent simulations are a rapidly growing field of research, but current simulations often lack clear modes for interaction and analysis, limiting the "what if" scenarios researchers are able to investigate. In this demo, we define three core operations for interacting with multi-agent simulations: inject, fork, and compare. Inject allows researchers to introduce external events at any point during simulation execution. Fork creates independent timeline branches from any timestamp, preserving complete state while allowing divergent exploration. Compare facilitates parallel observation of multiple branches, revealing how different interventions lead to distinct emergent behaviors. Together, these operations establish a vocabulary that transforms linear simulation workflows into interactive, explorable spaces. We demonstrate this vocabulary through a commodity market simulation with fourteen AI agents, where researchers can inject contrasting events and observe divergent outcomes across parallel timelines. By defining these fundamental operations, we provide a starting point for systematic causal investigation in LLM-based agent simulations, moving beyond passive observation toward active experimentation.

50d66ae117f14137.text: Large Language Models are increasingly used to simulate human opinion dynamics, yet the effect of genuine interaction is often obscured by systematic biases. We develop a Bayesian framework to disentangle and quantify three such biases: (i) A topic bias toward the LLM's default stance; (ii) an agreement bias favoring agreement to the prompted statement irrespective of the question; and (iii) an anchoring bias toward the initiating agent's stance. We apply this framework to various LLMs that performed multi-step dialogues on 12 different questions from climate change and societal justice to music preferences. We find that opinion trajectories tend to quickly converge to a shared attractor, with the influence of both interaction and biases decaying over time, and with the impact of biases differing between LLMs. In addition, we show that fine-tuning an LLM on different sets of strongly opinionated statements (including misinformation) shifts the opinion attractor correspondingly. By exposing stark differences between LLMs and providing quantitative tools for comparing interaction and bias contributions to opinion shifts in LLM agent discussions, our approach highlights both promises and pitfalls of using LLMs as proxies for human behavior.
50d66ae117f14137.abstract_zh:
大模型越来越多地被用来模拟人类观点动态，但真实交互的效果常被系统性偏差掩盖。作者开发了一个贝叶斯框架，用来分离并量化三类偏差：一是话题偏差，即模型偏向自己的默认立场；二是顺从偏差，即不管问题是什么都倾向于同意提示中的陈述；三是锚定偏差，即偏向发起对话的智能体的立场。

他们把这个框架用在多个大模型上，让智能体就 12 个不同问题进行多步对话，议题从气候变化、社会公正一直到音乐偏好。结果显示，观点轨迹会很快收敛到一个共享的吸引子，交互和偏差的影响都随时间衰减，偏差的影响程度在不同大模型之间差别很大。此外，作者还展示了用不同的一组强观点陈述（包括错误信息）微调大模型，会相应地移动观点吸引子的位置。

这项工作暴露了大模型之间的显著差异，并提供了量化工具来比较交互和偏差对大模型智能体讨论中观点变化的贡献，既指出了用大模型代理人类行为的潜力，也指出了其中的陷阱。
50d66ae117f14137.why: 它给了做舆论仿真的人一个可复用的量化方法，把“模型真的在交互”和“模型只是在顺从或锚定”区分开，这对判断大模型社会仿真的可信度是关键一步。

brief.question: LLM 模拟人类观点动态时，真实交互效应常被系统性偏差掩盖，作者要分离并量化这些偏差对观点变化的影响。
brief.setup: 多个 LLM 智能体就 12 个问题（气候变化、社会正义到音乐偏好）进行多步对话，具体智能体数量、环境与时间尺度未说明。
brief.method: 构建贝叶斯框架，分离并量化三种偏差：topic bias（偏向 LLM 默认立场）、agreement bias（无论问题内容都倾向同意所给陈述）、anchoring bias（偏向发起对话智能体的立场）。
brief.findings: 观点轨迹快速收敛到共同吸引子，交互和偏差的影响都随时间衰减，不同 LLM 之间偏差大小差异明显。用不同立场的强观点陈述（含错误信息）微调 LLM，观点吸引子会相应移动。
brief.validation: 未说明（材料未提及与真实人类数据对比或消融实验的具体结果）。
brief.limits: 作者指出用 LLM 作为人类行为代理存在风险（pitfalls），具体局限未说明。
brief.reuse: 贝叶斯偏差分离框架，可量化比较 LLM 讨论中交互与偏差对观点变化的贡献。

5ed1556735d62267.text: Generative Agent-Based Models (GABMs) powered by large language models (LLMs) offer promising potential for empirical logistics and supply chain management (LSCM) research by enabling realistic simulation of complex human behaviors. Unlike traditional agent-based models, GABMs generate human-like responses through natural language reasoning, which creates potential for new perspectives on emergent LSCM phenomena. However, the validity of LLMs as proxies for human behavior in LSCM simulations is unknown. This study evaluates LLM equivalence of human behavior through a controlled experiment examining dyadic customer-worker engagements in food delivery scenarios. I test six state-of-the-art LLMs against 957 human participants (477 dyads) using a moderated mediation design. This study reveals a need to validate GABMs on two levels: (1) human equivalence testing, and (2) decision process validation. Results reveal GABMs can effectively simulate human behaviors in LSCM; however, an equivalence-versus-process paradox emerges. While a series of Two One-Sided Tests (TOST) for equivalence reveals some LLMs demonstrate surface-level equivalence to humans, structural equation modeling (SEM) reveals artificial decision processes not present in human participants for some LLMs. These findings show GABMs as a potentially viable methodological instrument in LSCM with proper validation checks. The dual-validation framework also provides LSCM researchers with a guide to rigorous GABM development. For practitioners, this study offers evidence-based assessment for LLM selection for operational tasks.
5ed1556735d62267.abstract_zh:
生成式智能体模型（GABM）用大语言模型驱动智能体，通过自然语言推理产生类人反应，为物流与供应链管理（LSCM）的实证研究提供了模拟复杂人类行为的新途径。但大模型能否作为人类行为的有效替代，此前没有答案。

作者设计了一个受控实验，考察外卖配送场景中顾客与工作人员的双边互动，用有调节的中介设计，把六个最先进的大模型与957名真人参与者（477对互动）进行对比。

结果分两层。用两个单侧检验（TOST）做行为等价性检验，部分大模型在表层行为上与人类等价；但用结构方程模型（SEM）检验决策过程，发现某些模型存在真人参与者没有的人工决策路径。作者把这称为等价性与过程的悖论：行为结果看起来一样，背后的决策机制却不同。

由此作者提出GABM需要双重验证，一是人类等价性检验，二是决策过程验证，并为LSCM研究者提供了严格开发GABM的指南。对从业者而言，这项研究为运营任务中如何选大模型提供了基于证据的评估依据。
5ed1556735d62267.why: 它给出了一个可复用的双重验证框架，并用近千人的真人对照实验揭示了一个重要风险：模型行为与人类等价不代表决策过程与人类相同，做智能体仿真的人都需要这个提醒。

brief.question: LLM 驱动的生成式智能体模型（GABM）能否作为人类行为的有效替代，用于物流与供应链管理（LSCM）的实证仿真研究
brief.setup: 受控实验，场景为外卖配送中的顾客与骑手二元互动（dyadic customer-worker engagements）。测试六个 state-of-the-art LLM，对照组为 957 名人类参与者（477 个二元组）。
brief.method: 采用有调节的中介设计（moderated mediation design），提出双层验证框架：先用 TOST（Two One-Sided Tests）做人类等价性检验，再用结构方程模型（SEM）做决策过程验证。
brief.findings: 部分 LLM 在 TOST 检验中达到与人类的表面等价性，但 SEM 显示其中一些 LLM 存在人类参与者没有的人工决策过程，作者称之为 equivalence-versus-process paradox。结论是 GABM 在配合验证检查的前提下可作为 LSCM 研究的可行方法学工具。
brief.validation: 与 957 名人类参与者（477 个二元组）的实验数据对比，TOST 检验行为等价性，SEM 检验决策过程，属于双层实验验证，强度较高，但仅覆盖外卖配送这一种二元互动场景。
brief.limits: 等价性与过程不一致的悖论表明，仅看行为结果等价不足以判定 LLM 可替代人类；验证仅在外卖配送二元场景下完成，对更复杂的 LSCM 涌现现象的适用性未说明。
brief.reuse: 作者提出的双层验证框架（人类等价性检验加决策过程验证）可直接用于 LSCM 研究者构建和检验 GABM，也可作为从业者选择运营任务用 LLM 的评估依据。

5f8c126f4f362660.text: Understanding human behavior in urban environments is a crucial field within city sciences. However, collecting accurate behavioral data, particularly in newly developed areas, poses significant challenges.
